after..github/workflows/ship.yml:
name: Release

run-name: Release ${{ inputs.mode }} ${{ inputs.target_release }}

# Promote-by-digest and the separate synthetic staging lane. Production's
# deploy token is released only after the owner approves in the GitHub UI.
# Staging provider tokens are confined to its deploy/rollback steps; the CRM
# test job receives only the minimal synthetic fixture inputs.
# docs/release.md is the runbook; docs/emergency-rollback.md is the
# owner-run console fallback.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: dry-run, promote, rollback, stage, or urgent owner-only promote-without-staging
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: dry-run
        options:
          - dry-run
          - promote
          - rollback
          - stage
          - promote-without-staging
      drill:
        description: Staging-only failure rehearsal
        required: true
        type: choice
        default: none
        options:
          - none
          - e2e-fail
          - health-fail
          - bad-image
      target_release:
        description: Rollback only, a record tag such as prod-20261004T101500Z-0123abcd or prod-0000
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""

permissions: {}

# Serializes every Release run. The old launcher also treats any workflow
# with a top-level concurrency block it does not recognise as lock-relevant.
concurrency:
  group: ship-release
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

env:
  SHIP_REPOSITORY: medtechcorps-netizen/whatomate
  SHIP_WORKFLOW_PATH: .github/workflows/ship.yml
  PINNED_GH_VERSION: "2.98.0"
  PINNED_GH_URL: https://github.com/cli/cli/releases/download/v2.98.0/gh_2.98.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  PINNED_GH_SHA256: 3b8ac6b30336802fc1a858d7c084e11cdf24ac1a761ca90b68022d7d729208de
  PINNED_TRIVY_VERSION: "0.70.0"
  PINNED_TRIVY_URL: https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v0.70.0/trivy_0.70.0_Linux-64bit.tar.gz
  PINNED_TRIVY_SHA256: 8b4376d5d6befe5c24d503f10ff136d9e0c49f9127a4279fd110b727929a5aa9
  PINNED_SYFT_VERSION: "1.51.0"
  PINNED_SYFT_URL: https://github.com/anchore/syft/releases/download/v1.51.0/syft_1.51.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
  PINNED_SYFT_SHA256: 2a2e837a2c8d59ec9af5472ee22d3b04ee463c4e44476ecf993fd1e5ab6ebc7f
  PINNED_BUILDX_VERSION: v0.36.1
  PINNED_BUILDX_URL: https://github.com/docker/buildx/releases/download/v0.36.1/buildx-v0.36.1.linux-amd64
  PINNED_BUILDX_SHA256: 48af8a397ebd60178778bf63611dbcebe5f5e7a9be90eb9147b24b9587455778
  PINNED_BUILDKIT_IMAGE: docker.io/moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1@sha256:040d34121c27906c4ff9ac152a30d52bf2c5d328d3bb748916bb3d2743c02528

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Release plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Normal preflight is bounded at 2400s; retain 300s for setup and gates.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      actions: read
      attestations: read
      contents: read
    outputs:
      latest_release: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_release }}
      latest_manifest_sha256: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_manifest_sha256 }}
      latest_sha: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_sha }}
      target_release: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.target_release }}
      target_manifest_sha256: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.target_manifest_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned GitHub CLI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          install -m 0755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools_dir/gh"
          read -r gh_name gh_word gh_version _ < <("$tools_dir/gh" --version)
          [[ "$gh_name $gh_word $gh_version" == "gh version $PINNED_GH_VERSION" ]]
          printf 'SHIP_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools_dir/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Plan the release
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHIP_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          SHIP_DRILL: ${{ inputs.drill }}
          SHIP_TARGET_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.target_release }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py plan

  images:
    name: Release image (${{ matrix.component }})
    needs: plan
    if: ${{ contains(fromJSON('["dry-run","promote","stage","promote-without-staging"]'), inputs.mode) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        component:
          - web
          - meta-relay
          - gmail-relay
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require reviewed Dockerfile pins
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage pins --component "$COMPONENT"

      - name: Install pinned Trivy and Syft
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_TRIVY_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_TRIVY_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy.tar.gz" -C "$tools_dir" trivy
          [[ "$("$tools_dir/trivy" --version | awk '/^Version:/ {print $2; exit}')" == "$PINNED_TRIVY_VERSION" ]]
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_SYFT_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/syft.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_SYFT_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/syft.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/syft.tar.gz" -C "$tools_dir" syft
          "$tools_dir/syft" version | grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*Version:[[:space:]]+$PINNED_SYFT_VERSION$"
          printf '%s\n' "$tools_dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Install pinned Docker Buildx and start pinned BuildKit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          plugin_dir="$HOME/.docker/cli-plugins"
          mkdir -p "$plugin_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_BUILDX_URL" -o "$plugin_dir/docker-buildx"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_BUILDX_SHA256" "$plugin_dir/docker-buildx" | sha256sum --check --strict
          chmod 0755 "$plugin_dir/docker-buildx"
          [[ "$(docker buildx version | awk '{print $2}')" == "$PINNED_BUILDX_VERSION" ]]
          docker buildx create \
            --name rereply-ship \
            --driver docker-container \
            --driver-opt "image=$PINNED_BUILDKIT_IMAGE" \
            --use
          docker buildx inspect --bootstrap rereply-ship

      - name: Create a unique non-authority tag
        id: identity
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$COMPONENT" =~ ^(web|meta-relay|gmail-relay)$ ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          image="ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-$COMPONENT"
          tag="ship-${GITHUB_SHA:0:12}-r${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          [[ "$tag" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,127}$ ]]
          {
            printf 'tag=%s\n' "$tag"
            printf 'image=%s\n' "$image"
            printf 'image_ref=%s:%s\n' "$image" "$tag"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Build the exact AMD64 image without registry credentials
        uses: docker/build-push-action@10e90e3645eae34f1e60eeb005ba3a3d33f178e8 # v6
        env:
          DOCKER_BUILD_RECORD_UPLOAD: "false"
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./docker/release/${{ matrix.component }}.Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64
          push: false
          load: true
          pull: true
          no-cache: true
          provenance: false
          sbom: false
          builder: rereply-ship
          # The build reads the verified local checkout; never hand the
          # workflow token to BuildKit as a Git authentication secret.
          github-token: ""
          tags: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image_ref }}
          # UBUNTU_SNAPSHOT is deliberately not passed: the Dockerfile ARG
          # default is the exact value production was built with.
          build-args: |
            TARGETOS=linux
            TARGETARCH=amd64
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/medtechcorps-netizen/whatomate
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=ship-${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.title=rereply-release-${{ matrix.component }}
            io.rereply.release.workflow=ship

      - name: Publish the unique non-authority tag
        id: publish
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
          IMAGE_REF: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image_ref }}
          REGISTRY_USER: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$IMAGE_REF" == "$IMAGE:"* ]]
          trap 'docker logout ghcr.io >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
          printf '%s' "$GH_TOKEN" | docker login ghcr.io --username "$REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin
          docker push "$IMAGE_REF" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/docker-push.txt"
          mapfile -t pushed_digests < <(
            sed -nE 's/^.*digest:[[:space:]]*(sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})([[:space:]].*)?$/\1/p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/docker-push.txt"
          )
          [[ "${#pushed_digests[@]}" -eq 1 ]]
          digest="${pushed_digests[0]}"
          [[ "$digest" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          docker buildx imagetools inspect "$IMAGE@$digest" --raw > "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json"
          [[ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json" && ! -L "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json" ]]
          manifest_sha256="$(sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/published-manifest.json" | awk '{print $1}')"
          [[ "sha256:$manifest_sha256" == "$digest" ]]
          printf 'digest=%s\n' "$digest" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Verify the runtime contract
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          image_ref="$IMAGE@$DIGEST"
          install -d -m 0700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan"
          docker pull --platform linux/amd64 "$image_ref"
          docker image inspect "$image_ref" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/inspect.json"
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage contract --component "$COMPONENT"
          case "$COMPONENT" in
            web)
              docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 --entrypoint /bin/sh "$image_ref" \
                -ceu '
                  uid="$(id -u)"
                  test "$uid" -gt 0
                  test "$(id -un)" = rereply
                  model=/opt/piper/models/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx
                  config=/opt/piper/models/en_US-lessac-medium.onnx.json
                  test -s "$model" && test -r "$model" && test "$(stat -c %a "$model")" = 644
                  test -s "$config" && test -r "$config" && test "$(stat -c %a "$config")" = 644
                  test -s /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
                  test -r /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
                  test -x /usr/local/bin/piper
                  test -d /usr/share/espeak-ng-data
                  test -d /app/audio && test -w /app/audio
                  printf "%s\n" "release image smoke test" |
                    piper --model "$model" --output_file /app/audio/release-smoke.wav
                  test -s /app/audio/release-smoke.wav
                  opusenc --quiet /app/audio/release-smoke.wav /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg
                  test -s /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg
                  ffmpeg -nostdin -v error -i /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg -f null -
                  test "$(stat -c %u /app/audio/release-smoke.wav)" = "$uid"
                  test "$(stat -c %u /app/audio/release-smoke.ogg)" = "$uid"
                '
              docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 "$image_ref" version
              ;;
            meta-relay|gmail-relay)
              binary="/app/$COMPONENT"
              container_id="$(docker create --platform linux/amd64 "$image_ref")"
              trap 'docker rm -f "$container_id" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
              docker export "$container_id" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar"
              tar -xOf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" etc/passwd | grep -Fx 'relay:x:65532:65532:ReReply relay:/app:/sbin/nologin'
              tar -xOf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" etc/group | grep -Fx 'relay:x:65532:'
              tar -xOf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt > "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-ca-certificates.crt"
              [[ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-ca-certificates.crt" ]]
              tar -tvf "$RUNNER_TEMP/relay-rootfs.tar" | grep -E -- "^-rwx[^[:space:]]*[[:space:]].*[[:space:]]${binary#/}$"
              docker rm "$container_id" > /dev/null
              trap - EXIT
              ;;
            *)
              echo "::error::Unsupported runtime smoke contract."
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Check reviewed vulnerability exceptions
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py trivy-policy

      - name: Download a fresh Trivy database
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRIVY_CACHE_DIR="$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy-cache"
          trivy image \
            --cache-dir "$TRIVY_CACHE_DIR" \
            --download-db-only \
            --skip-version-check
          /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage trivy-db --component "$COMPONENT"

      - name: Fail on embedded secrets
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          trivy image \
            --cache-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy-cache" \
            --skip-db-update \
            --skip-version-check \
            --scanners secret \
            --image-config-scanners secret \
            --exit-code 1 \
            --format json \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/secret-report.json" \
            --timeout 30m \
            "$IMAGE@$DIGEST"

      - name: Fail on HIGH or CRITICAL vulnerabilities
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          trivy image \
            --cache-dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/trivy-cache" \
            --skip-db-update \
            --skip-version-check \
            --scanners vuln \
            --pkg-types os,library \
            --severity HIGH,CRITICAL \
            --ignorefile release/deployment/ship.trivyignore \
            --exit-code 1 \
            --format json \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/vulnerability-report.json" \
            --timeout 30m \
            "$IMAGE@$DIGEST"

      - name: Generate the SPDX SBOM
        env:
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
          SYFT_CHECK_FOR_APP_UPDATE: "false"
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          syft scan "docker:$IMAGE@$DIGEST" --output "spdx-json=$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-scan/sbom.spdx.json"

      - name: Record the image
        env:
          COMPONENT: ${{ matrix.component }}
          DIGEST: ${{ steps.publish.outputs.digest }}
          IMAGE: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.image }}
          TAG: ${{ steps.identity.outputs.tag }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py image --stage record --component "$COMPONENT"

      - name: Upload the image record
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: ship-image-${{ matrix.component }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-image/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  attest:
    name: Release attestations
    needs:
      - plan
      - images
    if: ${{ contains(fromJSON('["dry-run","promote","stage","promote-without-staging"]'), inputs.mode) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      attestations: write
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    outputs:
      candidate_b64: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.candidate_b64 }}
      candidate_sha256: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.candidate_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - name: Refuse re-runs
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
          RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME: ${{ runner.environment }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RUN_ATTEMPT" == "1" ]]
          [[ "$GITHUB_REF" == "refs/heads/main" ]]
          [[ "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_NAME" == "github-hosted" ]]

      - name: Check out the dispatched commit
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install pinned GitHub CLI
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tools_dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/ship-tools"
          install -d -m 0755 "$tools_dir"
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --fail --silent --show-error --location --retry 3 \
            "$PINNED_GH_URL" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz"
          printf '%s  %s\n' "$PINNED_GH_SHA256" "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          install -m 0755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/gh_${PINNED_GH_VERSION}_linux_amd64/bin/gh" "$tools_dir/gh"
          read -r gh_name gh_word gh_version _ < <("$tools_dir/gh" --version)
          [[ "$gh_name $gh_word $gh_version" == "gh version $PINNED_GH_VERSION" ]]
          printf 'SHIP_GH_BIN=%s\n' "$tools_dir/gh" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Download the three image records
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4
        with:
          pattern: ship-image-*-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images
          merge-multiple: false

      - name: Read the three image records
        id: images
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py candidate --stage read

      - name: Attest web provenance
        id: prov-web
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-web
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.web }}
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest web SBOM
        id: sbom-web
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-web
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.web }}
          sbom-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images/ship-image-web-${{ github.run_id }}/sbom.spdx.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest meta-relay provenance
        id: prov-meta-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-meta-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.meta_relay }}
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest meta-relay SBOM
        id: sbom-meta-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-meta-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.meta_relay }}
          sbom-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images/ship-image-meta-relay-${{ github.run_id }}/sbom.spdx.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest gmail-relay provenance
        id: prov-gmail-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-gmail-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.gmail_relay }}
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Attest gmail-relay SBOM
        id: sbom-gmail-relay
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/medtechcorps-netizen/rereply-release-gmail-relay
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.images.outputs.gmail_relay }}
          sbom-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/ship-images/ship-image-gmail-relay-${{ github.run_id }}/sbom.spdx.json
          push-to-registry: false

      - name: Verify every attestation
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SHIP_PROV_BUNDLE_WEB: ${{ steps.prov-web.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_SBOM_BUNDLE_WEB: ${{ steps.sbom-web.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_PROV_BUNDLE_META_RELAY: ${{ steps.prov-meta-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_SBOM_BUNDLE_META_RELAY: ${{ steps.sbom-meta-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_PROV_BUNDLE_GMAIL_RELAY: ${{ steps.prov-gmail-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
          SHIP_SBOM_BUNDLE_GMAIL_RELAY: ${{ steps.sbom-gmail-relay.outputs.bundle-path }}
        run: /usr/bin/python3 -I -S -B release/deployment/ship.py candidate --stage verify

      - name: Require anonymous pullability
        env:
          DOCKER_CONFIG: ${{ runner.temp }}/anonymous-docker-config

  deploy-staging:

                  elif isinstance(value, dict):
                      for child in value.values(): mask(child)
                  elif isinstance(value, list):
                      for child in value: mask(child)

              def unique_object(pairs):
                  result = {}
                  for key, value in pairs:
                      if key in result: raise ValueError()
                      result[key] = value
                  return result

              # Mask every canary string, including any nested hash-shaped value.

    or network call occurs on import; construction checks the actual CLI version.

    def __init__(self, binary, token, config_dir, *, seconds=300, base_env=None,
                 capture=runtime.bounded_command, clock=time.monotonic):
        _need(type(seconds) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(seconds) and 0 < seconds <= 600, "collect-budget")
        self._clock, self._capture = clock, capture
        self._last = clock()
        _need(type(self._last) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(self._last), "collect-clock")
        self._deadline = self._last + seconds
        self._commands, self._bytes, self._transcript = 0, 0, hashlib.sha256()
        self._failure_category = None
        self._scope = self._verification_args = None
        self._downloads, self._used_downloads = set(), set()
        self._used = False

        if not valid:
            self._note_failure("deadline")
        _need(valid, "collect-deadline")
        self._last = now

        return any(p.fullmatch(path) for p in _GETS)

        remaining_bytes = MAX_BYTES - self._bytes
        _need(self._commands < MAX_COMMANDS and remaining_bytes > STDERR_LIMIT, "collect-bound")
        try:
            _need(_directory(self._config) == self._config_identity, "collect-directory-changed")
            timeout = self._remaining(duration + CLEANUP_RESERVE) - CLEANUP_RESERVE
            if timeout <= 0:
                self._note_failure("deadline")
            _need(timeout > 0, "collect-deadline")
            stdout_limit = min(limit, remaining_bytes - STDERR_LIMIT)
            self._commands += 1
            env = dict(self._env)

                    stdout_limit=stdout_limit, stderr_limit=STDERR_LIMIT)

            _need(_directory(self._config) == self._config_identity, "collect-directory-changed")
            valid = (type(result.returncode) is int and type(result.stdout) is bytes and type(result.stderr) is bytes

def _pages(client, base, key, maximum):
    output, ids, total = [], set(), None
    # A full final page is followed by one bounded empty sentinel.
    for page in range(1, maximum // PAGE + 2):
        value = client.get(base + ("" if base.endswith("?") else "&") + f"per_page=100&page={page}")
        _need(type(value) is dict and type(value.get(key)) is list, "collect-page")
        count = _integer(value.get("total_count"), maximum, 0)
        _need(total is None or total == count, "collect-page-changed")
        total = count
        rows = value[key]
        _need(len(rows) <= PAGE, "collect-page")
        for row in rows:
            _need(type(row) is dict, "collect-page")
            identity = _integer(row.get("id"))
            _need(identity not in ids, "collect-duplicate")
            ids.add(identity); output.append(row)
        _need(len(output) <= total, "collect-page-count")
        if len(rows) < PAGE:
            _need(len(output) == total, "collect-page-count")
            return output
    raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "collect-page-bound")

          and _hash(request.workflow_bytes) == WORKFLOW_SHA256, "collect-workflow-source")
    # Parsing is restricted to these exact reviewed bytes, not generic YAML.
    steps, job = {}, None
    for line in request.workflow_bytes.decode("ascii").splitlines():
        if re.fullmatch(r"  (release-preview|compat-run|compat|attest):", line):
            job = line.strip()[:-1]
            if job == "attest": job = "compat-attest"
            steps[job] = []
        elif job and line.startswith("      - name: "):
            steps[job].append(line[len("      - name: "):])

    return steps

def _safe_projection(value):
    if isinstance(value, datetime): return value.isoformat()
    if type(value) is evidence.Job: return tuple(getattr(value,k) for k in value.__slots__)
    if type(value) is evidence.ExecutionWindow: return [_safe_projection(value.started_at), _safe_projection(value.completed_at), value.fresh]
    if type(value) in (tuple,list): return [_safe_projection(v) for v in value]
    if type(value) is dict: return {str(k):_safe_projection(v) for k,v in value.items()}
    return value


def _collect_history(request, client, scratch, *, wall_clock, retain=False):
    """Collect once; no policy grant and no claim against deleted whole runs."""
    steps = _workflow(request)
    _need(type(client) is ActionsGh and not client._used, "collect-client-reuse")
    client._used = True
    try:
        _directory(scratch)
        start = wall_clock()
        _need(type(start) is datetime and start.tzinfo == timezone.utc, "collect-clock")
        if retain:
            attempts, first, artifacts, before = _snapshot(client, request, steps, wall_clock(), retain=True)
        else:
            attempts, first, artifacts = _snapshot(client, request, steps, wall_clock())
        issues = []
        for i, attempt in enumerate(attempts):
            name = f"compat-result-{request.sha}-{attempt.run_attempt}"
            meta = next((m for m in artifacts[attempt.run_id] if m["name"] == name), None)
            measurement = attempt.measurement
            if meta is not None:
                if meta["expired"]:
                    measurement = evidence.MissingEvidence.EXPIRED
                else:
                    try:
                        _need(attempt.started_at is not None and attempt.started_at <= meta["created"]
                              and (attempt.completed_at is None or meta["updated"] <= attempt.completed_at), "collect-artifact-period")
                        measurement = client._pair(meta, attempt, scratch)
                    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
                        measurement = evidence.MissingEvidence.UNKNOWN
                        issues.append("artifact-unverified")
            attempts[i] = replace(attempt, measurement=measurement)
        enumeration, second = "complete-visible", None
        if retain:
            after = None
        try:
            if retain:
                used = len(before.runs) + sum(len(row.raw) for row in before.attempts)
                used += sum(len(row.measurement.result) + len(row.measurement.context) for row in attempts
                            if type(row.measurement) is evidence.AuthenticatedPair)
                _, second, _, after = _snapshot(client, request, steps, wall_clock(), retain=True,
                    retention_limit=MAX_OUTAGE_RAW_BYTES - used)
            else:
                _, second, _ = _snapshot(client, request, steps, wall_clock())
            if second != first:
                enumeration = "incomplete"; issues.append("inventory-changed")
        except evidence.CompatRefusal:
            enumeration = "incomplete"; issues.append("inventory-unavailable")
        end = wall_clock()
        _need(type(end) is datetime and end.tzinfo == timezone.utc and start <= end, "collect-clock")
        try:
            client._remaining(1)
        except evidence.CompatRefusal:
            enumeration = "incomplete"; issues.append("collection-deadline")

            {"begin":first,"end":second,"transcript":transcript,"started":start,"observed":end})))

        return normal

                           git_binary: Path, producer_sha: str,
                           target_tag: str) -> RollbackProofResolution:
    """Prepare a current-main/current-v0 dormant span without authorizing it.

    The exact source operation retains the complete authenticated chain and
    both signed endpoint image identities. No normal ForwardResolution or
    favorable compatibility flag can replace this operation's inputs.
    """
    return _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, target_tag, producer_sha,
                    forward=False, rollback_proof=True)


def resolve_rollback_admission(client: transport.ReleaseGh, repo_dir: Path,
                               git_binary: Path, producer_sha: str,
                               target_tag: str) -> RollbackResolution | RollbackProofResolution:
    """Select the guarded legacy/image-only lane or prepare dedicated evidence.

    Source selection happens inside one original authenticated operation. A
    proof-shaped result still requires fresh all-head compatibility evidence;
    this entry never substitutes a normal receipt or removes the public hold.
    """
    return _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, target_tag, producer_sha,
                    forward=False, rollback_admission=True)


def _rollback_proof_source(reader, repo_dir, chain, latest, selected, producer):
    requirements = policy._rollback_requirements(chain, selected.release)
    if requirements.non_none_count < 2:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-not-required")
    span = (requirements.target, *requirements.intermediates)
    if (producer.mode != "reviewed-v0" or not requirements.runtime_source_supported
            or any(entry.facts.db_change != "none" and
                   (entry.facts.db_change not in {"data", "expand"} or not entry.facts.dormant)
                   for entry in requirements.intermediates)):
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")
    # Shape alone is insufficient: this first lane also requires identical
    # source-bound registry and seed bytes. Future transitions stay closed.
    sources = {producer.sha: producer}
    for entry in span:
        sources[entry.reader.sha] = entry.reader
        if entry.live is not None:
            origin = entry.live.origin_source
            if (origin.mode != "reviewed-v0" or entry.live.catalog != producer.catalog
                    or origin.catalog != entry.live.catalog or origin.artifacts != producer.artifacts):
                raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")
            sources[origin.sha] = origin
    origin_sha = requirements.live.origin_source.sha
    for base in sorted({latest.record_sha, origin_sha}):
        if base != producer.sha and reader.output(repo_dir, ["merge-base", base, producer.sha],
                code="git-failed:source-ancestry") != (base + "\n").encode("ascii"):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")
    endpoints = {selected.actual_web_source_sha, latest.actual_web_source_sha}
    expected = dict(producer.artifacts)
    materials = []
    for sha, facts in sorted(sources.items()):
        legacy = (facts.mode == "legacy-reader0" and sha == policy.V0_RELEASED_SOURCE
                  and sha in endpoints)
        if facts.mode not in {"reviewed-v0", "legacy-reader0"}:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")
        if facts.mode == "reviewed-v0" and (facts.catalog != producer.catalog
                                            or facts.artifacts != producer.artifacts):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")
        observations, total = [], 0
        for path in policy.SOURCE_PATHS:
            raw = reader.read_blob(sha, path)
            if legacy and path in {policy.PROFILE, policy.OVERLAY}:
                valid = raw is None
            else:
                valid = type(raw) is bytes and bool(raw) and common.sha256_bytes(raw) == expected[path]
            if not valid:
                raise policy.PolicyRefusal("rollback-proof-source-unsupported")
            total += len(raw) if raw is not None else 0
            if total > policy.MAX_SOURCE_BYTES:
                raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
            observations.append(BlobObservation(path, raw))
        materials.append(RollbackSourceMaterial(sha, "legacy-e001-absent-overlay" if legacy
                         else "equal-reviewed-v0", tuple(observations)))
    workflow = reader.read_blob(producer.sha, ".github/workflows/compat.yml")
    if not workflow:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    target_recipe = _web_recipe(reader, selected)
    live_recipe = target_recipe if latest.actual_web_source_sha == selected.actual_web_source_sha else _web_recipe(reader, latest)
    return requirements, workflow, tuple(materials), target_recipe, live_recipe


def _rollback_source(chain, repo_dir, selected_tag):
    if chain.entries[-1].live is not None:
        return None, None, policy.rollback_plan(chain, selected_tag)
    # Keep the pre-v2 emergency route available without inventing a measured
    # live tuple. These are the original canonical v1 bytes, not v2 coercions.
    if any(entry.facts.schema_version != 1 for entry in chain.entries):
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-policy-legacy-live-unavailable")
    documents = tuple(common.loads_strict(item.raw) for item in chain.inputs)
    entries = (records.bootstrap_entry(documents[0], chain.inputs[0].manifest_sha256),
               *(records.manifest_entry(document, item.raw)
                 for document, item in zip(documents[1:], chain.inputs[1:], strict=True)))
    legacy = records.Chain(entries)
    target, _intermediates = records.rollback_plan(legacy, selected_tag)
    classification = schema_change.guard(repo_dir, target.sha, legacy.latest.sha, mode="rollback")
    return legacy, classification, None


def _catalog_material(reader, latest, selected, candidate):
    def observations(sha, absent=()):
        result = []
        for path in _CATALOG_PATHS:
            raw = reader.read_blob(sha, path)
            if path in absent:
                valid = raw is None
            else:
                valid = type(raw) is bytes and common.sha256_bytes(raw) == _CATALOG_PINS[path]
            if not valid:
                raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-unsupported")
            result.append(BlobObservation(path, raw))
        return tuple(result)

    candidate_observations = observations(candidate.sha)
    candidate_hashes = dict(candidate.artifacts)
    if any(candidate_hashes.get(row.path) != common.sha256_bytes(row.raw) for row in candidate_observations):
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    candidate_blobs = tuple(policy.SourceBlob(row.path, row.raw) for row in candidate_observations)
    if latest.live is not None:
        origin = latest.live.origin_source
        if origin.mode != "reviewed-v0" or latest.live.catalog != origin.catalog:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-unsupported")
        baseline_sha, provenance = origin.sha, "retained-live-v2"
        baseline = observations(baseline_sha)
        origin_hashes = dict(origin.artifacts)
        if any(origin_hashes.get(row.path) != common.sha256_bytes(row.raw) for row in baseline):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    else:
        # Source comparison and selected image catalog fallback are distinct.
        # This proves fixed source observations, never a legacy live contract.
        baseline_sha = selected.actual_web_source_sha
        if baseline_sha == policy.V0_RELEASED_SOURCE:
            provenance = "legacy-e001-absent-overlay"
            baseline = observations(baseline_sha, (policy.PROFILE, policy.OVERLAY))
        else:
            provenance = "legacy-equal-reviewed-v0"
            baseline = observations(baseline_sha)
    return CatalogMaterial(candidate.sha, candidate_blobs, baseline_sha, provenance, baseline)


def _web_recipe(reader, selected):
    raw = reader.read_blob(selected.actual_web_source_sha, _WEB_RECIPE)
    if not raw:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    return WebRecipe(selected.actual_web_source_sha, _WEB_RECIPE, raw, common.sha256_bytes(raw))


def _forward_source(reader, repo_dir, latest, candidate):
    candidate_sha = candidate.sha
    database_base = latest.live.origin_source.sha if latest.live is not None else latest.record_sha
    for base in sorted({latest.record_sha, database_base}):
        if base != candidate_sha and reader.output(repo_dir, ["merge-base", base, candidate_sha],
                code="git-failed:source-ancestry") != (base + "\n").encode("ascii"):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-policy-invalid")
    classification = schema_change.classify_v2(repo_dir, database_base, candidate_sha)
    workflow = reader.read_blob(candidate_sha, ".github/workflows/compat.yml")
    if not workflow:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    return candidate, classification, workflow, database_base


def _audit_roles(database_base, latest_sha, web_sha):
    grouped = {}
    for role, sha in (("database-origin", database_base), ("latest-record", latest_sha),
                      ("selected-web", web_sha)):
        if type(sha) is not str or common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(sha) is None:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        grouped.setdefault(sha, []).append(role)
    return tuple((sha, tuple(roles)) for sha, roles in sorted(grouped.items()))


def validate_forward_audit(audit, *, candidate_sha, database_base_source,
                           latest_record_sha, selected_web_source_sha):
    """Check a complete immutable projection; this cannot authenticate bytes.

    The diff cap covers the complete canonical range projection. Drill bytes
    retain the existing source-file cap and are not interpreted here: malformed
    irrelevant drill metadata must not accidentally become a required gate.
    """
    def need(ok):
        if not ok:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")

    need(type(candidate_sha) is str and common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(candidate_sha) is not None)
    need(type(audit) is ForwardAuditMaterial and audit.candidate_sha == candidate_sha)
    need(type(audit.drills) is BlobObservation and audit.drills.path == _DRILLS
         and (audit.drills.raw is None or (type(audit.drills.raw) is bytes
              and len(audit.drills.raw) <= policy.MAX_SOURCE_FILE_BYTES)))
    expected = _audit_roles(database_base_source, latest_record_sha, selected_web_source_sha)
    need(type(audit.changes) is tuple and len(audit.changes) == len(expected))
    projection = []
    for row, (base, roles) in zip(audit.changes, expected, strict=True):
        need(type(row) is ChangedRange and type(row.roles) is tuple and row.roles == roles
             and row.base_sha == base and row.head_sha == candidate_sha
             and type(row.rows) is tuple and len(row.rows) <= MAX_CHANGED_PATHS)
        paths = []
        for item in row.rows:
            need(type(item) is ChangedPath and type(item.status) is str
                 and item.status in ("A", "D", "M", "T", "U", "X")
                 and source_git._path(item.path))
            paths.append(item.path)
        need(paths == sorted(set(paths)))
        need(base != candidate_sha or not row.rows)
        projection.append({"roles": roles, "base_sha": base, "head_sha": candidate_sha,
                           "rows": [(item.status, item.path) for item in row.rows]})
    need(len(common.canonical_file_bytes(projection)) <= MAX_AUDIT_BYTES)
    return audit


def _forward_audit(reader, repo_dir, latest, selected, candidate_sha, database_base):
    drills = BlobObservation(_DRILLS, reader.read_blob(candidate_sha, _DRILLS))
    changes = []
    for base, roles in _audit_roles(database_base, latest.record_sha, selected.actual_web_source_sha):
        raw = reader.output(repo_dir, ["diff", "--no-renames", "--name-status", "-z",
                            base, candidate_sha, "--"], code="git-failed:source-audit")
        if type(raw) is not bytes or (raw and not raw.endswith(b"\0")):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        fields = raw.split(b"\0")[:-1] if raw else []
        if len(fields) % 2 or len(fields) > MAX_CHANGED_PATHS * 2:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        rows = tuple(ChangedPath(fields[i].decode("ascii"), fields[i + 1].decode("utf-8"))
                     for i in range(0, len(fields), 2))
        changes.append(ChangedRange(roles, base, candidate_sha,
                                    tuple(sorted(rows, key=lambda item: item.path))))
    return validate_forward_audit(ForwardAuditMaterial(candidate_sha, drills, tuple(changes)),
        candidate_sha=candidate_sha, database_base_source=database_base,
        latest_record_sha=latest.record_sha, selected_web_source_sha=selected.actual_web_source_sha)


def _forward_pending(reader, repo_dir, latest_sha, candidate_sha, database_base, material, classification):
    """Retain complete observations; malformed plans stay blocked previews.

    Endpoint capture/framing/mode/bounds failures are hard resolver refusals.
    Complete observed invalid plans and intermediate history remain explicitly
    blocked previews; no raw endpoint bytes are omitted or replaced by absence.
    """
    active = {row.path: row.raw for row in material.candidate_blobs}
    active_args = dict(active_catalog=active[policy.GOLDEN], active_globals=active[policy.GLOBALS],
                       active_history=active[policy.HISTORY])
    inventories = {}
    for sha in sorted({candidate_sha, latest_sha}):
        raw = reader.output(repo_dir, ["ls-tree", "-r", "--name-only", "-z", sha, "--",
                            pending_source.plan.PREFIX.rstrip("/")], code="git-failed:source-pending")
        if type(raw) is not bytes or len(raw) > pending_source.MAX_FILE_BYTES or (raw and not raw.endswith(b"\0")):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        names = raw[:-1].decode("utf-8").split("\0") if raw else []
        if (len(names) > 3 or names != sorted(set(names))
                or any(pending_source._FILE.fullmatch(name) is None for name in names)):
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
        files = []
        for path in names:
            body = reader.read_blob(sha, path)
            if type(body) is not bytes or not 0 < len(body) <= pending_source.MAX_FILE_BYTES:
                raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
            files.append(pending_source.PendingBlob(path, body))
        inventories[sha] = tuple(files)
    pending = pending_source.PendingMaterial(candidate_sha, latest_sha,
        inventories[candidate_sha], inventories[latest_sha])
    if (sum(len(raw) for raw in active_args.values())
            + sum(len(row.raw) for rows in (pending.candidate_files, pending.previous_files) for row in rows)
            > pending_source.MAX_MATERIAL_BYTES):
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    reasons, requirements = set(classification.reasons), set(classification.requirements)
    summary = [line for line in classification.summary if not line.startswith("policy classification:")]
    kind, dormant = classification.kind, classification.dormant
    if latest_sha != database_base:
        # Rollback can separate latest source from database origin. Endpoint
        # hashes cannot reveal a transient plan removal/replacement on this
        # second range. Reuse only the bounded pending traversal, not a second
        # complete classifier. Its reads share the original Git/outer budgets.
        range_reasons, range_requirements, range_summary = set(), set(), []
        try:
            introduced = schema_change._v2_pending(schema_change._Repository(repo_dir), latest_sha,
                candidate_sha, range_reasons, range_summary, range_requirements)
            if introduced and kind == "none":
                kind, dormant = "expand", True
        except (schema_change._Invalid, UnicodeError, TypeError, ValueError, KeyError, RecursionError):
            reasons.add("classifier-v2-invalid:pending-latest-record")
            requirements.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "producer-class-unsupported"))
        reasons.update(range_reasons)
        requirements.update(range_requirements)
        summary.extend(line for line in range_summary if line not in summary)
    try:
        projection = pending_source.replay(pending, candidate_sha=candidate_sha, previous_sha=latest_sha, **active_args)
        if projection.plan is not None and any(entry.kind != "expand" for entry in projection.plan.entries):
            reasons.add("pending-format-unsupported")
            requirements.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "producer-class-unsupported"))
    except pending_source.PendingSourceRefusal:
        reasons.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "classifier-v2-invalid:pending-material"))
        requirements.update(("pending-format-unsupported", "producer-class-unsupported"))
    summary.append("policy classification: " + kind + (" (dormant)" if dormant else ""))
    if len(summary) > 25000:
        raise policy.PolicyRefusal("record-source-invalid")
    for line in (*reasons, *summary):
        common.require_public_text(line)
    classification = schema_change.PolicyClassification(kind, dormant, tuple(sorted(reasons)), tuple(summary),
        classification.migration_changes, tuple(sorted(requirements)))
    return pending, classification


# These endpoint pins come from the reviewed source-only production blueprint,
# not from an observed graph or application-golden catalog. Version 1 below is
# planned source intent only; active source and live coordinates stay at v0.
_NULLABLE_PREFIX = "internal/dbcatalog/profiles/nullable-column-v1/"
_NULLABLE_BEFORE = "1c85a9ad0b9bb652ea21b51faa2ee887592dacb00c7f4b388de5ef5d6085a4e7"
_NULLABLE_AFTER = "a8f15ea159883aacdeecd3c55100f3b589f10ca18708ba113a393805cbf9948e"
_NULLABLE_OPERATION = "c775d31243e85e933598b06d3828cc329460902b27d1f0f1a9b2b62a022424d2"
_NULLABLE_DESCRIPTOR = "0d20f14c144d0230d4afb2b98b9bf106bc08577c69160af41dc014d8ebafa946"
_NULLABLE_SLOTS = (
    ("before", "catalog-v0.json", 4 << 20, _NULLABLE_BEFORE),
    ("candidate_baseline", "catalog-v0.json", 4 << 20, _NULLABLE_BEFORE),
    ("candidate_probe", "probe-operation.json", 2 << 10, _NULLABLE_OPERATION),
    ("descriptor", "transition-v1.json", 16 << 10, _NULLABLE_DESCRIPTOR),
    ("operation", "operation-v1.json", 2 << 10, _NULLABLE_OPERATION),
    ("after", "catalog-v1.json", 4 << 20, _NULLABLE_AFTER),
)


def _nullable_sources(reader, budget, latest, candidate):
    """Collect six fixed slots without manufacturing legacy live metadata.

    Every present slot is validated, even on an unavailable path. Endpoint
    pins do not assert profile namespace history or a named migration step.
    """
    def need(condition):
        if not condition:
            raise policy.PolicyRefusal("nullable-profile-incomplete")

    def current_v0(source):
        return (source.mode == "reviewed-v0" and source.catalog is not None
                and source.catalog.catalog_version == 0
                and source.catalog.min_reader_version == 0
                and source.catalog.catalog_sha256 == _NULLABLE_BEFORE)

    budget.check()
    need(current_v0(candidate))
    live = latest.live
    if live is not None:
        need(current_v0(live.origin_source) and live.catalog == live.origin_source.catalog)
    before_sha = latest.record_sha if live is None else live.origin_source.sha
    provenance = "legacy-record-only" if live is None else "live-origin"
    observations, total = [], 0
    for slot, suffix, limit, _pin in _NULLABLE_SLOTS:
        sha = before_sha if slot == "before" else candidate.sha
        path = _NULLABLE_PREFIX + suffix
        raw = reader.read_blob(sha, path)
        if raw is not None:
            need(type(raw) is bytes and 0 < len(raw) <= limit)
            total += len(raw)
            # Count logical roles including duplicate SHA/path/raw before any
            # decoding. AG independently retains its own four-slot limit.
            need(total <= 8 << 20)
        observations.append(NullableSourceObservation(slot, sha, path, raw))
    budget.check()
    for row, (_slot, _suffix, _limit, pin) in zip(observations, _NULLABLE_SLOTS, strict=True):
        if row.raw is None:
            continue
        need(common.sha256_bytes(row.raw) == pin)
        if row.slot in ("before", "candidate_baseline", "after"):
            nullable._catalog(row.raw)
        elif row.slot in ("candidate_probe", "operation"):
            nullable.semantic.parse_operation(row.raw)
        else:
            # Canonical closed document decoding plus the exact reviewed pin
            # validates this present descriptor without inventing an origin.
            nullable._fields(nullable.wire._load(row.raw, nullable.MAX_DESCRIPTOR),
                ("format_version", "profile", "postgres_major", "observation_version",
                 "default_acl_contract_sha256", "renderer", "operation", "before", "after"))
    before, baseline, probe, descriptor, operation, after = observations
    plans = (descriptor.raw is not None, operation.raw is not None, after.raw is not None)
    need(all(plans) or not any(plans))
    need((baseline.raw is None) == (probe.raw is None))
    need(not any(plans) or baseline.raw is not None)
    if before.raw is not None and baseline.raw is not None:
        need(before.raw == baseline.raw)
    unavailable = tuple(code for code, absent in (
        ("legacy-live-unavailable", live is None),
        ("origin-profile-missing", before.raw is None),
        ("candidate-plan-missing", not any(plans))) if absent)
    target = nullable.CatalogCoordinates(1, 0, _NULLABLE_AFTER) if all(plans) else None
    material = bound = None
    if all(plans) and before.raw is not None:
        material = nullable.ProfileMaterial(*(nullable.SourceBlob(row.source_sha, row.path, row.raw)
            for row in (descriptor, operation, before, after)))
    if not unavailable:
        origin = nullable.RetainedOrigin(live.origin_release, live.origin_manifest_sha256,
            before_sha, nullable.CatalogCoordinates(0, 0, live.catalog.catalog_sha256))
        bound = nullable.bind_source_profile(origin,
            nullable.CandidateSource(candidate.sha, target), material)
    budget.check()
    return before_sha, provenance, tuple(observations), unavailable, target, material, bound


def _resolve_nullable_profile(client: transport.ReleaseGh, repo_dir: Path,
                              git_binary: Path, candidate_sha: str) -> NullableProfilePreparation:
    """Private source preparation; no observations, transition or main authority."""
    return _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, None, candidate_sha,
                    forward=True, nullable_profile=True)

def resolve_outage_forward(client: transport.ReleaseGh, repo_dir: Path,
                           git_binary: Path, candidate_sha: str) -> OutageForwardResolution:
    """Capture configured lineage data within the original source operation.

    Noncoverage is data until outage is selected. No source fact or Python
    holder supplies signature authority, and no new allowance is created.
    """
    return _resolve(client, repo_dir, git_binary, None, candidate_sha,
                    forward=True, admission=True, outage=True)


def _outage_blob(reader, budget, sha, path, remaining):
    import compat_negative_index as index
    raw = reader.output(reader.repo, ["ls-tree", "-z", sha, "--", path], code="unused")
    if not raw:
        return PublisherBlob(sha, path, None, None)
    rows = raw.split(b"\0")
    meta, sep, name = rows[0].partition(b"\t")
    mode, kind, oid = meta.split(b" ")
    if (len(rows) != 2 or rows[1] or not sep or name != path.encode("ascii")
            or mode not in (b"100644", b"100755") or kind != b"blob"
            or common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(oid.decode("ascii")) is None):
        budget.fail("outage-source")
    size = reader.output(reader.repo, ["cat-file", "-s", oid.decode("ascii")], code="unused").strip()
    if not size.isdigit() or not 0 <= int(size) <= min(index.MAX_SOURCE, remaining):
        budget.fail("outage-source-bound")
    value = reader.output(reader.repo, ["cat-file", "blob", oid.decode("ascii")], code="unused")
    if len(value) != int(size):
        budget.fail("outage-source")
    return PublisherBlob(sha, path, mode.decode("ascii"), value)


def _outage_sources(reader, budget, candidate_sha):
    import compat_outage_policy as loader
    import compat_negative_index as index
    installed = loader.require_consumer_policy()
    policy_blob = _outage_blob(reader, budget, candidate_sha, loader.DATA_PATH, index.MAX_CONFIG)
    if policy_blob.raw != installed.raw:
        budget.fail("outage-policy-source")
    ancestors, blobs, namespaces, total = [], [], [], 0
    for lineage in installed.lineage:
        producer = lineage.producer_sha
        if reader.output(reader.repo, ["cat-file", "-t", producer], code="unused") != b"commit\n":
            budget.fail("outage-producer")
        raw = reader.output(reader.repo, ["merge-base", producer, candidate_sha], code="unused")
        if len(raw) != 41 or raw[-1:] != b"\n" or common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(raw[:-1].decode("ascii")) is None:
            budget.fail("outage-ancestry")
        ancestors.append(PublisherAncestry(producer, candidate_sha, raw[:-1].decode("ascii")))
        for sha in (producer, candidate_sha):
            namespace = reader.output(reader.repo, [*source_git._PUBLISHER_TREE_ARGS, sha, "--",
                *source_git._PUBLISHER_PATHS], code="unused")
            total += len(namespace)
            if total > index.MAX_SOURCE_TOTAL:
                budget.fail("outage-source-bound")

                "command-failed": "command-nonzero", "signature": "signature",
                "image-verification": "signature", "bound": "bound",
            }.get(detail, "other")
        self.failed = True
        raise _failure(detail) from None

    def remaining(self):
        if self.failed or self.closed:
            self.fail("closed")
        now = self._clock()
        if not _finite(now) or not self._last <= now < self._deadline:
            self.fail("deadline")

    if not directory.is_dir():
        return paths
    for path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):
        if path.suffix not in {".yml", ".yaml"} or not path.is_file():

def report_schema_block(out: common.Output, exc: schema_change.SchemaChangeBlocked) -> None:
    lines = ["refused: schema-change-blocked (release classifier)"]
    for reason in exc.reasons[:50]:
        try:
            lines.append("  " + common.require_public_text(reason, out.private))
        except common.ReleaseError:
            lines.append("  (path withheld)")
    for line in lines:
        safe_text(out, line)
    try:
        out.summary(["### Release refused", "", *lines])
    except (common.ReleaseError, OSError):
        pass


def safe_text(out: common.Output, line: str) -> None:
    try:
        out.text(line)
    except common.ReleaseError:
        out.text("refused: output-unsafe")


def schema_summary(result: schema_change.Classification) -> list[str]:
    state = " (dormant)" if result.dormant else ""
    return [f"- Schema classification: {result.kind}{state}", *["- " + line for line in result.summary]]


def _digest_lines(images: Mapping[str, str]) -> list[str]:
    return [f"- {component}: {images[component]}" for component in common.COMPONENTS]

def cmd_plan(ctx: Context) -> int:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + ship_flow.PLAN_SECONDS
    out = ctx.out
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    sha = control["sha"]
    mode, target_release = parse_mode(ctx.env)
    active_exceptions = None
    if mode in CANDIDATE_MODES:
        active_exceptions = trivy_policy.check(ctx.deps.trivy_policy_path, ctx.now().date())
    gh = ctx.gh()
    # The owner-only approval rule must be enforced by the environment
    # before anyone is asked to approve (production re-checks it).
    if mode in PRODUCTION_MODES:
        release_record.require_approval_gate(gh)
    if mode in CANDIDATE_MODES:
        require_ci_green(gh, sha)
    require_old_lanes_idle(gh, ctx.repo_dir)
    gate = ship_flow.gate(ctx, control, mode, target_release, deadline=deadline)
    chain = gate.resolved.chain
    latest = gate.resolved.latest
    lines = [
        "## Release plan",
        "",
        f"- Mode: {mode}",
        f"- Commit: {sha}",
        f"- Latest record: {latest.release} ({chain.entries[-1].kind}, commit {latest.record_sha})",
    ]
    if mode in PRODUCTION_MODES:
        lines.append("- Approval gate: environment production requires the owner's review (admin bypass off, main only)")
    else:
        lines.append("- Staging only: separate staging environments; no production deployment or record")
    outputs = {
        "latest_release": latest.release,
        "latest_manifest_sha256": latest.manifest_sha256,
        "latest_sha": latest.record_sha,
        "target_release": "",
        "target_manifest_sha256": "",
    }
    if mode in CANDIDATE_MODES:
        classification = gate.classification
        count, commits = first_parent_commits(out, ctx.repo_dir, latest.record_sha, sha)
        lines += [
            "- No-downgrade: the commit descends from the latest record",
            "- Schema guard: clean",
            *schema_summary(classification),
            "- CI: Test and E2E push runs on main succeeded for this commit",
            "- Old release lanes: idle",
            f"- Active Trivy exceptions: {active_exceptions}",
            "",
            f"### First-parent commits since {latest.release} ({count})",
            "",
            *commits,
        ]
        if count > len(commits):
            lines.append(f"- ... and {count - len(commits)} more")
        if mode in PRODUCTION_MODES:
            lines += ["", "The production job deploys only if live digests equal the latest record."]
        else:
            lines += ["", "Staging verifies the configured target, deployment receipt and all thirteen canary checks."]
    else:
        target = gate.resolved.selected
        intermediates = chain.entries[target.index + 1:]
        classification = gate.classification
        outputs["target_release"] = target.release
        outputs["target_manifest_sha256"] = target.manifest_sha256
        lines += [
            f"- Rollback target: {target.release} (commit {target.record_sha})",
            *_digest_lines(dict(target.images)),
            f"- Records after the target: {len(intermediates)}",
            "- Source and exact-target rollback policy: passed",
            *(schema_summary(classification) if classification is not None else []),
            "- Old release lanes: idle",
            "",
            "The production job reads live digests and decides: rollback (live equals the latest "
            "record; one PUT to the target), reconcile (live already equals the target; no PUT, "
            "record only) or restore (target is the latest record and live matches no record; one "
            "PUT back to the latest record).",
        ]
    lines += ship_flow.details(gate)
    if mode in PRODUCTION_MODES:
        lines += ["", APPROVAL_BANNER]
    if mode == BYPASS_MODE:
        lines += ["", *BYPASS_BANNER]
    elif mode == "promote":
        lines += ["", "Production additionally requires this run's bound thirteen-check staging report."]
    out.set_outputs(outputs)
    out.summary(lines)
    out.text(f"plan ok: {mode} at {sha}; latest record {latest.release}")
    if mode in PRODUCTION_MODES:
        out.text(APPROVAL_BANNER)
    if mode == BYPASS_MODE:
        for line in BYPASS_BANNER:
            out.text(line)
    return EXIT_OK

def _require_component(component: Any) -> str:
    if component not in common.COMPONENTS:
        common.fail("input-invalid:component")
    return component


def _logical_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    lines: list[str] = []
    current = ""
    for raw in text.split("\n"):
        stripped = raw.strip()
        if not current and (not stripped or stripped.startswith("#")):
            continue
        if raw.rstrip().endswith("\\"):
            current += raw.rstrip()[:-1] + " "
            continue
        current += raw
        lines.append(current.strip())
        current = ""
    if current.strip():
        lines.append(current.strip())
    return lines


PINNED_FROM_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._/:-]*@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")
CHECKSUM_RE = re.compile(r"^--checksum=sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$")


def check_dockerfile_pins(repo_dir: Path, component: str) -> str:
    """docker/release/<c>.Dockerfile is a tracked regular 100644 blob, every
    FROM is name@sha256 (or scratch, or an earlier stage), every remote ADD
    carries --checksum, and COPY/RUN --from only names earlier stages."""
    code = "dockerfile-pin-invalid"
    relative = DOCKERFILES[component]
    path = repo_dir / relative
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        common.fail(code)
    listing = [item for item in release_record.git_output(
        repo_dir, ["ls-tree", "-z", "HEAD", "--", relative], code="git-failed:ls-tree"
    ).split(b"\x00") if item]
    if len(listing) != 1:
        common.fail(code)
    meta, _, name = listing[0].partition(b"\t")
    fields = meta.split(b" ")
    if name.decode("utf-8", "replace") != relative or fields[:2] != [b"100644", b"blob"] or len(fields) != 3:
        common.fail(code)
    hashed = release_record.git_output(repo_dir, ["hash-object", "--", relative], code="git-failed:hash-object").strip()
    if hashed != fields[2]:
        common.fail(code)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    try:
        text = raw.decode("ascii")
    except UnicodeError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    if "\r" in text:
        common.fail(code)
    first = text.lstrip("\n").split("\n", 1)[0].replace(" ", "").lower()
    if first.startswith("#syntax=") or first.startswith("#escape=") or first.startswith("#check="):
        common.fail(code)
    stages: set[str] = set()
    saw_from = False
    for line in _logical_lines(text):
        tokens = line.split()
        instruction = tokens[0].upper()
        arguments = tokens[1:]
        if instruction == "FROM":
            saw_from = True
            flags = [item for item in arguments if item.startswith("--")]
            rest = [item for item in arguments if not item.startswith("--")]
            if any(flag != "--platform=linux/amd64" for flag in flags) or not rest:
                common.fail(code)
            image = rest[0]
            if len(rest) not in (1, 3) or (len(rest) == 3 and rest[1].lower() != "as"):
                common.fail(code)
            if not (image == "scratch" or image.lower() in stages or PINNED_FROM_RE.fullmatch(image)):
                common.fail(code)
            if len(rest) == 3:
                stages.add(rest[2].lower())
        elif instruction == "ADD":
            sources = [item for item in arguments if not item.startswith("--")]
            remote = [item for item in sources[:-1] if "://" in item or item.startswith("git@")]
            checksums = [item for item in arguments if item.startswith("--checksum")]
            if remote:
                if len(remote) != 1 or not remote[0].startswith("https://"):
                    common.fail(code)
                if len(checksums) != 1 or CHECKSUM_RE.fullmatch(checksums[0]) is None:
                    common.fail(code)
        elif instruction in {"COPY", "RUN"}:
            for item in arguments:
                if not item.startswith("--"):
                    break
                if item.startswith("--from="):
                    if item[len("--from="):].lower() not in stages:
                        common.fail(code)
                elif item.startswith("--mount="):
                    for part in item[len("--mount="):].split(","):
                        key, _, value = part.partition("=")
                        if key == "from" and value.lower() not in stages:
                            common.fail(code)
        elif instruction == "ONBUILD":
            common.fail(code)
    if not saw_from:
        common.fail(code)
    return common.sha256_bytes(raw)


def _scan_dir(ctx: Context) -> Path:
    path = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-scan"
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_dir():
        common.fail("artifact-invalid:scan-dir")
    return path


def _image_identity(ctx: Context, component: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    image = ctx.env.get("IMAGE")
    if image != common.IMAGE_REPOSITORY[component]:
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:image")
    digest = common.require_digest(ctx.env.get("DIGEST"), "image-contract-differs:digest")
    return image, digest


def check_image_contract(ctx: Context, component: str, sha: str) -> None:
    """build-attest-exact-release-images.yml:1309-1336 in Python."""
    code = "image-contract-differs"
    image, digest = _image_identity(ctx, component)
    inspect = common.load_json(_scan_dir(ctx) / "inspect.json", "image-contract-differs:inspect", canonical=False, decimals=True)
    if type(inspect) is not list or len(inspect) != 1 or type(inspect[0]) is not dict:
        common.fail(code)
    item = inspect[0]
    if item.get("Os") != "linux" or item.get("Architecture") != "amd64":
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:platform")
    repo_digests = item.get("RepoDigests")
    if type(repo_digests) is not list or f"{image}@{digest}" not in repo_digests:
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:repo-digest")
    config = item.get("Config")
    if type(config) is not dict:
        common.fail(code)
    expected = IMAGE_CONTRACT[component]
    ports = config.get("ExposedPorts")
    if (
        config.get("User") != expected["user"]
        or config.get("WorkingDir") != expected["working_dir"]
        or config.get("Entrypoint") != expected["entrypoint"]
        or config.get("Cmd") != expected["cmd"]
        or type(ports) is not dict
        or expected["port"] not in ports
    ):
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:runtime")
    labels = config.get("Labels")
    if type(labels) is not dict or (
        labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.source") != "https://github.com/medtechcorps-netizen/whatomate"
        or labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.revision") != sha
        or labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.version") != f"ship-{sha}"
        or labels.get("org.opencontainers.image.title") != f"rereply-release-{component}"
        or labels.get("io.rereply.release.workflow") != "ship"
    ):
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:labels")


def parse_rfc3339(value: Any, code: str) -> dt.datetime:
    if type(value) is not str:
        common.fail(code)
    match = re.fullmatch(
        r"([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2})T([0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})(?:\.[0-9]{1,9})?(Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})",
        value,
    )
    if match is None:
        common.fail(code)
    zone = "+00:00" if match.group(3) == "Z" else match.group(3)
    try:
        parsed = dt.datetime.fromisoformat(f"{match.group(1)}T{match.group(2)}{zone}")
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    return parsed.astimezone(dt.timezone.utc)


def check_trivy_db(ctx: Context) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The fresh (unpinned) Trivy DB must be at most 48 hours old."""
    code = "image-contract-differs:trivy-db"
    database_dir = ctx.runner_temp() / "trivy-cache" / "db"
    metadata_path = database_dir / "metadata.json"
    database_path = database_dir / "trivy.db"
    for path in (metadata_path, database_path):
        if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
            common.fail(code)
    raw = metadata_path.read_bytes()
    if len(raw) > 65536:
        common.fail(code)
    metadata = common.loads_strict(raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if type(metadata) is not dict:
        common.fail(code)
    updated = parse_rfc3339(metadata.get("UpdatedAt", metadata.get("updatedAt")), code)
    age = (ctx.now() - updated).total_seconds()
    if not TRIVY_DB_MIN_AGE_SECONDS <= age <= TRIVY_DB_MAX_AGE_SECONDS:
        common.fail(code)
    version = ctx.env.get("PINNED_TRIVY_VERSION")
    if type(version) is not str or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+", version) is None:
        common.fail(code)
    record = {
        "updated_at": common.format_timestamp(updated.replace(microsecond=0)),
        "metadata_sha256": common.sha256_bytes(raw),
        "version": version,
    }
    target = _scan_dir(ctx) / "trivy-db.json"
    if target.exists() or target.is_symlink():
        common.fail("artifact-invalid:exists")
    target.write_bytes(common.canonical_file_bytes(record))
    return record


def _require_reports(scan: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], bytes, bytes, bytes]:
    code = "artifact-invalid:reports"
    sbom_raw = (scan / "sbom.spdx.json").read_bytes() if (scan / "sbom.spdx.json").is_file() else b""
    vuln_raw = (scan / "vulnerability-report.json").read_bytes() if (scan / "vulnerability-report.json").is_file() else b""
    secret_raw = (scan / "secret-report.json").read_bytes() if (scan / "secret-report.json").is_file() else b""
    for name in ("sbom.spdx.json", "vulnerability-report.json", "secret-report.json"):
        if (scan / name).is_symlink():
            common.fail(code)
    if not sbom_raw or not vuln_raw or not secret_raw or len(sbom_raw) > 256 * 1024 * 1024:
        common.fail(code)
    sbom = common.loads_strict(sbom_raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if (
        type(sbom) is not dict
        or sbom.get("spdxVersion") != "SPDX-2.3"
        or type(sbom.get("documentNamespace")) is not str
        or not sbom["documentNamespace"]
        or type(sbom.get("packages")) is not list
        or not sbom["packages"]
    ):
        common.fail(code)
    vulnerabilities = common.loads_strict(vuln_raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if type(vulnerabilities) is not dict or type(vulnerabilities.get("Results")) is not list:
        common.fail(code)
    for result in vulnerabilities["Results"]:
        if type(result) is not dict:
            common.fail(code)
        for finding in result.get("Vulnerabilities") or []:
            if type(finding) is not dict or finding.get("Severity") in {"HIGH", "CRITICAL"}:
                common.fail(code)
    secrets = common.loads_strict(secret_raw, decimals=True, code=code)
    if type(secrets) is not dict or type(secrets.get("Results")) is not list:
        common.fail(code)
    for result in secrets["Results"]:
        if type(result) is not dict or result.get("Secrets"):
            common.fail(code)
    return sbom, sbom_raw, vuln_raw, secret_raw


def record_image(ctx: Context, component: str, control: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    sha = control["sha"]
    image, digest = _image_identity(ctx, component)
    tag = ctx.env.get("TAG")
    if tag != f"ship-{sha[:12]}-r{control['run_id']}":
        common.fail("image-contract-differs:tag")
    check_image_contract(ctx, component, sha)
    dockerfile_sha256 = check_dockerfile_pins(ctx.repo_dir, component)
    scan = _scan_dir(ctx)
    _sbom, sbom_raw, vuln_raw, secret_raw = _require_reports(scan)
    trivy = common.load_json(scan / "trivy-db.json", "artifact-invalid:trivy-db")
    trivy = common.exact_keys(trivy, {"updated_at", "metadata_sha256", "version"}, "artifact-invalid:trivy-db")
    active_exceptions = trivy_policy.check(ctx.deps.trivy_policy_path, ctx.now().date())
    record = {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "component": component,
        "image": image,
        "digest": digest,
        "sha": sha,
        "tag": tag,
        "tag_is_authority": False,
        "dockerfile": DOCKERFILES[component],
        "dockerfile_sha256": dockerfile_sha256,
        "built_at": common.format_timestamp(ctx.now()),
        "sbom_sha256": common.sha256_bytes(sbom_raw),
        "trivy": {
            "version": trivy["version"],
            "db_updated_at": trivy["updated_at"],
            "db_metadata_sha256": trivy["metadata_sha256"],
            "active_exceptions": active_exceptions,
        },
    }
    validate_image_record(record, component, sha)
    output = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-image"
    if output.exists() or output.is_symlink():
        common.fail("artifact-invalid:exists")
    output.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    (output / "image.json").write_bytes(common.canonical_file_bytes(record))
    (output / "sbom.spdx.json").write_bytes(sbom_raw)
    (output / "vulnerability-report.json").write_bytes(vuln_raw)
    (output / "secret-report.json").write_bytes(secret_raw)
    return record


def validate_image_record(value: Any, component: str, sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "artifact-invalid:image-record"
    record = common.exact_keys(
        value,
        {
            "schema_version", "component", "image", "digest", "sha", "tag",
            "tag_is_authority", "dockerfile", "dockerfile_sha256", "built_at",
            "sbom_sha256", "trivy",
        },
        code,
    )
    if (
        record["schema_version"] != 1
        or record["component"] != component
        or record["image"] != common.IMAGE_REPOSITORY[component]
        or record["sha"] != sha
        or record["tag_is_authority"] is not False
        or record["dockerfile"] != DOCKERFILES[component]
    ):
        common.fail(code)
    common.require_digest(record["digest"], code)
    common.exact_string(record["tag"], code, re.compile(r"ship-[0-9a-f]{12}-r[1-9][0-9]{0,14}"))
    if not record["tag"].startswith(f"ship-{sha[:12]}-r"):
        common.fail(code)
    common.require_sha256(record["dockerfile_sha256"], code)
    common.require_timestamp(record["built_at"], code)
    common.require_sha256(record["sbom_sha256"], code)
    trivy = common.exact_keys(record["trivy"], {"version", "db_updated_at", "db_metadata_sha256", "active_exceptions"}, code)
    common.exact_string(trivy["version"], code)
    common.require_timestamp(trivy["db_updated_at"], code)
    common.require_sha256(trivy["db_metadata_sha256"], code)
    common.exact_int(trivy["active_exceptions"], code, 0, trivy_policy.MAX_ENTRIES)
    return record


def cmd_image(ctx: Context, stage: str, component: str) -> int:
    component = _require_component(component)
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    if stage == "pins":
        dockerfile_sha256 = check_dockerfile_pins(ctx.repo_dir, component)
        ctx.out.text(f"{DOCKERFILES[component]}: pins reviewed (sha256 {dockerfile_sha256})")
    elif stage == "contract":
        check_image_contract(ctx, component, control["sha"])
        ctx.out.text(f"{component}: runtime contract verified")
    elif stage == "trivy-db":
        record = check_trivy_db(ctx)
        ctx.out.text(f"Trivy database updated at {record['updated_at']}")
    elif stage == "record":
        record = record_image(ctx, component, control)
        ctx.out.text(f"{component}: {record['image']}@{record['digest']} recorded")
    else:
        common.fail("input-invalid:stage")
    return EXIT_OK


def cmd_trivy_policy(ctx: Context) -> int:
    common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    count = trivy_policy.check(ctx.deps.trivy_policy_path, ctx.now().date())
    ctx.out.text(f"reviewed Trivy exceptions valid: {count} active")
    return EXIT_OK
