def read_image_records(ctx: Context, control: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    code = "artifact-invalid:inventory"
    root = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-images"
    if root.is_symlink() or not root.is_dir():
        common.fail(code)
    expected = {f"ship-image-{component}-{control['run_id']}": component for component in common.COMPONENTS}
    entries = list(os.scandir(root))
    if {entry.name for entry in entries} != set(expected):
        common.fail(code)
    records: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    for entry in entries:
        if not stat.S_ISDIR(entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_mode):
            common.fail(code)
        component = expected[entry.name]
        directory = Path(entry.path)
        files = list(os.scandir(directory))
        if {item.name for item in files} != set(IMAGE_FILES):
            common.fail(code)
        for item in files:
            if not stat.S_ISREG(item.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_mode):
                common.fail(code)
        record = validate_image_record(
            common.load_json(directory / "image.json", "artifact-invalid:image-record"),
            component,
            control["sha"],
        )
        if common.sha256_bytes((directory / "sbom.spdx.json").read_bytes()) != record["sbom_sha256"]:
            common.fail("artifact-invalid:sbom")
        records[component] = record
    digests = [records[component]["digest"] for component in common.COMPONENTS]
    if len(set(digests)) != 3:
        common.fail(code)
    return records


def cmd_candidate(ctx: Context, stage: str) -> int:
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env)
    records = read_image_records(ctx, control)
    root = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-images"
    if stage == "read":
        ctx.out.set_outputs(
            {
                "web": records["web"]["digest"],
                "meta_relay": records["meta-relay"]["digest"],
                "gmail_relay": records["gmail-relay"]["digest"],
            }
        )
        ctx.out.text("image records read: 3")
    elif stage == "verify":
        gh = ctx.gh()
        for component in common.COMPONENTS:
            record = records[component]
            suffix = STAGE_SUFFIX[component]
            bundles = []
            for kind in ("PROV", "SBOM"):
                raw = ctx.env.get(f"SHIP_{kind}_BUNDLE_{suffix}")
                if type(raw) is not str or not raw:
                    common.fail("artifact-invalid:bundle")
                path = Path(raw)
                if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size == 0:
                    common.fail("artifact-invalid:bundle")
                bundles.append(str(path))
            arguments = dict(
                signer_workflow=release_record.SHIP_SIGNER,
                signer_digest=control["workflow_sha"],
                source_digest=control["sha"],
            )
            gh.verify_image(record["image"], record["digest"], predicate_type=release_record.SLSA_PREDICATE,
                            bundle=bundles[0], **arguments)
            sbom_results = gh.verify_image(record["image"], record["digest"],
                                           predicate_type=release_record.SPDX_PREDICATE, bundle=bundles[1], **arguments)
            sbom = common.loads_strict((root / f"ship-image-{component}-{control['run_id']}" / "sbom.spdx.json").read_bytes(),
                                       decimals=True, code="artifact-invalid:sbom")
            if not any(_statement_predicate(item) == sbom for item in sbom_results):
                common.fail("attestation-unverified:sbom")
            gh.verify_image(record["image"], record["digest"], predicate_type=release_record.SLSA_PREDICATE, **arguments)
        ctx.out.text("attestations verified (signer ship.yml, ref main)")
    elif stage == "assemble":
        exceptions = {records[component]["trivy"]["active_exceptions"] for component in common.COMPONENTS}
        if len(exceptions) != 1:
            common.fail("artifact-invalid:trivy")
        candidate = {
            "schema_version": 1,
            "sha": control["sha"],
            "workflow_sha": control["workflow_sha"],
            "built_at": min(records[component]["built_at"] for component in common.COMPONENTS),
            "images": {component: records[component]["digest"] for component in common.COMPONENTS},
            "trivy": {
                "db_updated_at": min(records[component]["trivy"]["db_updated_at"] for component in common.COMPONENTS),
                "active_exceptions": exceptions.pop(),
            },
        }
        validate_candidate(candidate)
        raw = common.canonical_file_bytes(candidate)
        ctx.out.set_outputs(
            {
                "candidate_b64": base64.b64encode(raw).decode("ascii"),
                "candidate_sha256": common.sha256_bytes(raw),
            }
        )
        ctx.out.summary(
            [
                "## Release candidate",
                "",
                f"- Commit: {candidate['sha']}",
                *_digest_lines(candidate["images"]),
                f"- Trivy database updated at: {candidate['trivy']['db_updated_at']}",
                f"- Active Trivy exceptions: {candidate['trivy']['active_exceptions']}",
                "- attestations verified (signer ship.yml, ref main)",
            ]
        )
        ctx.out.text("candidate assembled")
        if ctx.env.get("SHIP_MODE") == BYPASS_MODE:
            ctx.out.summary(["", *BYPASS_BANNER])
    else:
        common.fail("input-invalid:stage")
    return EXIT_OK


def _statement_predicate(item: Any) -> Any:
    try:
        return item["verificationResult"]["statement"]["predicate"]
    except (KeyError, TypeError):
        return None


def validate_candidate(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "candidate-invalid"
    candidate = common.exact_keys(value, {"schema_version", "sha", "workflow_sha", "built_at", "images", "trivy"}, code)
    if candidate["schema_version"] != 1:
        common.fail(code)
    common.require_sha1(candidate["sha"], code)
    common.require_sha1(candidate["workflow_sha"], code)
    common.require_timestamp(candidate["built_at"], code)
    images = spec_images.require_image_set(candidate["images"], code)
    if len(set(images.values())) != 3:
        common.fail(code)
    trivy = common.exact_keys(candidate["trivy"], {"db_updated_at", "active_exceptions"}, code)
    common.require_timestamp(trivy["db_updated_at"], code)
    common.exact_int(trivy["active_exceptions"], code, 0, trivy_policy.MAX_ENTRIES)
    return candidate


def decode_candidate(env: Mapping[str, str], control: Mapping[str, Any], now: dt.datetime) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "candidate-invalid"
    encoded = env.get("CANDIDATE_B64")
    expected = env.get("CANDIDATE_SHA256")
    if type(encoded) is not str or not encoded or re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}", encoded) is None:
        common.fail(code)
    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(encoded, validate=True)
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    if common.sha256_bytes(raw) != common.require_sha256(expected, code):
        common.fail(code)
    candidate = validate_candidate(common.loads_strict(raw, code=code))
    if raw != common.canonical_file_bytes(candidate):
        common.fail(code)
    if candidate["sha"] != control["sha"] or candidate["workflow_sha"] != control["workflow_sha"]:
        common.fail("candidate-invalid:foreign-sha")
    age = now - common.require_timestamp(candidate["built_at"], code)
    if age < dt.timedelta(0) or age > CANDIDATE_MAX_AGE:
        common.fail("candidate-stale")
    return candidate

def parse_target_secret(raw: Any) -> dict[str, str]:
    code = "target-invalid:production-target"
    if type(raw) is not str or not raw or len(raw) > 4096:
        common.fail(code)
    value = common.exact_keys(
        common.loads_strict(raw, code=code), {"schema_version", "app_id", "postgres_cluster_id"}, code
    )
    if value["schema_version"] != 1:
        common.fail(code)
    app_id = common.require_uuid(value["app_id"], code)
    cluster_id = common.require_uuid(value["postgres_cluster_id"], code)
    if app_id == cluster_id:
        common.fail(code)
    return {"app_id": app_id, "postgres_cluster_id": cluster_id}


def production_worst_case_seconds() -> int:
    """Upper bound of one production run that deploys, fails at the end and
    rolls back: the forward path and the rollback path each run one PUT, a
    reconcile, a settle and a full failing smoke. Each poll loop may overrun
    its wall-clock deadline by one sleep plus one iteration of GETs."""
    get = do_app.GET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    reconcile = do_app.RECONCILE_DEADLINE_SECONDS + do_app.POLL_SECONDS + 2 * get
    settle = do_app.SETTLE_DEADLINE_SECONDS + do_app.POLL_SECONDS + 4 * get
    smoke_seconds = (
        smoke.ROUNDS * len(smoke.HEALTH) * smoke.SOCKET_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        + (smoke.ROUNDS - 1) * smoke.ROUND_DELAY_SECONDS
    )
    forward = do_app.PUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS + reconcile + settle + smoke_seconds
    rollback = 2 * get + do_app.PUT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS + reconcile + settle + smoke_seconds
    return PREAMBLE_BUDGET_SECONDS + forward + rollback


def _interrupt(signum: int, frame: Any) -> None:
    del signum, frame
    raise KeyboardInterrupt


class _Run:
    """Mutable state of one production run, for exit-code classification."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.put_attempted = False
        self.clients: list[do_app.DOAppClient] = []


def run_production(ctx: Context) -> int:
    # The protected values leave the process environment before anything
    # else runs, so no subprocess can ever inherit them.
    token = ctx.env.pop("SHIP_DO_TOKEN", None)
    target_raw = ctx.env.pop("SHIP_TARGET_JSON", None)
    out = ctx.out
    run = _Run()
    # GitHub stops a cancelled or timed-out job with SIGINT, then SIGTERM;
    # both end in the classified handler below instead of a bare exit.
    installed = threading.current_thread() is threading.main_thread()
    previous_handler: Any = signal.SIG_DFL
    if installed:
        previous_handler = signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, _interrupt)
    try:
        return _production(ctx, token if type(token) is str else "", target_raw, run)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        if run.put_attempted:
            safe_text(out, "cancelled after the PUT: the job was interrupted")
            safe_text(out, MANUAL_LINE)
            return EXIT_MANUAL
        safe_text(out, "cancelled before the PUT; production unchanged")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except schema_change.SchemaChangeBlocked as exc:
        report_schema_block(out, exc)
        return EXIT_MANUAL if run.put_attempted else EXIT_REFUSED
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        if run.put_attempted:
            safe_text(out, f"failed after the PUT: {exc.code}")
            safe_text(out, MANUAL_LINE)
            return EXIT_MANUAL
        safe_text(out, f"refused: {exc.code}; production unchanged")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - reported by class-free constant only
        if run.put_attempted:
            safe_text(out, "failed after the PUT: internal-error")
            safe_text(out, MANUAL_LINE)
            return EXIT_MANUAL
        safe_text(out, "refused: internal-error; production unchanged")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    finally:
        if installed:
            signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, previous_handler if previous_handler is not None else signal.SIG_DFL)
        for client in run.clients:
            client.scrub()
        token = None
        target_raw = None


def _same_state(left: do_app.Snapshot, right: do_app.Snapshot) -> bool:
    return (left.public, left.spec, left.active_id) == (right.public, right.spec, right.active_id)


def _production(ctx: Context, token: str, target_raw: Any, run: _Run) -> int:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + ship_flow.PLAN_SECONDS
    env = ctx.env
    out = ctx.out
    deps = ctx.deps
    # P0 context, ambient credentials and target identity, before any I/O.
    dispatched_mode, target_release = parse_mode(env)
    # Break-glass uses the existing promote path and manifest kind throughout.
    mode = "promote" if dispatched_mode == BYPASS_MODE else dispatched_mode
    if dispatched_mode not in PRODUCTION_MODES:
        common.fail("input-invalid:production-mode")
    control = common.validate_context(env)
    if any(name in env for name in common.FORBIDDEN_AMBIENT) or any(name.startswith("STAGING_") for name in env):
        common.fail("context-invalid:forbidden-ambient-credential")
    if not token:
        common.fail("target-invalid:token")
    out.add_private(token)
    secret = parse_target_secret(target_raw)
    out.add_mask(secret["app_id"])
    out.add_mask(secret["postgres_cluster_id"])
    target = ctx.ship_target()
    if common.sha256_text(secret["app_id"]) != target["app_id_sha256"]:
        common.fail("app-identity-mismatch")
    sha = control["sha"]
    if dispatched_mode == "promote":
        # These are public same-run outputs, never staging provider credentials.
        # Validate them before GitHub or DigitalOcean access in this command.
        import stage_evidence
        stage_evidence.verify(env, control=control, candidate=decode_candidate(env, control, ctx.now()),
            pins=common.load_json(deps.staging_pins_path, "target-invalid:staging-pins"), production=target)
    # P1 inputs.
    if mode == "rollback":
        if target_release != env.get("PLAN_TARGET_RELEASE"):
            common.fail("latest-changed-since-plan:target")
    elif env.get("PLAN_TARGET_RELEASE", "") != "" or env.get("PLAN_TARGET_MANIFEST_SHA256", "") != "":
        common.fail("input-invalid:plan-target")
    gh = ctx.gh()
    # P1a the owner-only approval rule, before any DigitalOcean I/O: the
    # environment still requires the owner's review, and the owner approved
    # this run's production job.
    release_record.require_approval_gate(gh)
    release_record.require_owner_approval(gh, control["run_id"])
    # P2 old-lane quiescence.
    require_old_lanes_idle(gh, ctx.repo_dir)
    # P3 the verified record chain, bound to what the owner approved.
    bootstrap = ctx.bootstrap()
    gate = ship_flow.gate(ctx, control, dispatched_mode, target_release, deadline=deadline)
    chain = gate.resolved.chain
    latest = gate.resolved.latest
    if latest.release != env.get("PLAN_LATEST_RELEASE") or latest.manifest_sha256 != env.get("PLAN_LATEST_MANIFEST_SHA256"):
        common.fail("latest-changed-since-plan")
    # P4 desired images.
    candidate: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    target_entry: ship_flow.record_resolver.ReleaseSelection | None = None
    handoff_outputs = None
    if mode in {"dry-run", "promote"}:
        candidate = decode_candidate(env, control, ctx.now())
        desired_images = dict(candidate["images"])
        if set(desired_images.values()) & set(bootstrap["images"].values()):
            common.fail("candidate-invalid:bootstrap-digest")
        release_record.verify_images(gh, desired_images, sha, bootstrap)
        classification = gate.classification
        # Encoding, size and full decode/replay must succeed before even the
        # first provider read. Oversized evidence cannot strand a deployment.
        handoff_outputs = ship_flow.promotion_outputs(gate, control, desired_images,
            staging="passed" if dispatched_mode == "promote" else "bypassed", private=out.private)
    else:
        target_entry = gate.resolved.selected
        if target_entry.manifest_sha256 != env.get("PLAN_TARGET_MANIFEST_SHA256"):
            common.fail("latest-changed-since-plan:target")
        # The concrete full-chain reader verified every selected image.
        classification = gate.classification
        desired_images = dict(target_entry.images)
        handoff_outputs = ship_flow.rollback_outputs(gate, control, private=out.private)
    for line in (schema_summary(classification) if classification is not None else []) + ship_flow.details(gate):
        safe_text(out, line)
    if gate.qualified_rollback is not None:
        # Custody encoding may consume time. This is a fresh production clock
        # check before provider I/O, never a record-retry qualification clock.
        proof = gate.qualified_rollback
        try:
            observed = ship_flow.ship_rollback_compat._utc(ctx.deps.clock())
        except ship_flow.compat_evidence.CompatRefusal:
            common.fail("candidate-invalid:compat-stale")
        if not proof.checked_at <= observed < proof.artifact_expires_at:
            common.fail("candidate-invalid:compat-stale")
    if gate.outage is not None:
        # Use the original deadline and the full-precision clock after custody
        # encoding. Completion/record retries do not get a new admission clock.
        ship_flow.require_outage_freshness(gate, deadline=deadline, observed_at=ctx.deps.clock())
    # P5 two identical double reads, digest sources, topology and VPC.
    client = do_app.DOAppClient(
        secret["app_id"],
        secret["postgres_cluster_id"],
        token,
        expected_app_id_sha256=target["app_id_sha256"],
        allow_put=mode in PUT_MODES,
        opener=deps.opener,
    )
    run.clients.append(client)
    before = do_app.observe_stable(client)
    _mask_observation(out, client, before)
    spec_images.require_digest_sources(before.spec)
    cluster_name = spec_images.require_topology(before.spec, target)
    out.add_mask(cluster_name)
    origin, host = smoke.canonical_origin(before.ingress, target["default_ingress_sha256"])
    out.add_mask(host)
    out.add_mask(origin)
    live_images = spec_images.extract_image_digests(before.spec)
    # P6 drift.
    if mode in {"dry-run", "promote"}:
        if live_images != dict(latest.images):
            common.fail("drift")
        case = mode
    else:
        assert target_entry is not None
        case = ship_flow.rollback_case(live_images, gate.resolved)
        desired_images = dict(latest.images if case == "restore" else target_entry.images)
    # P7 backup gate (every mode, dry-run included).
    backup = backup_check.check(client, target=target, now=ctx.now())
    out.text(f"backup gate: newest PostgreSQL backup is {backup['age_hours']} h old (limit 36 h)")
    # P9r rollback reconcile: production already runs the target.
    if case == "reconcile":
        assert target_entry is not None
        health = ctx.health(origin)
        again = do_app.observe_stable(client)
        if not _same_state(again, before):
            common.fail("cas-changed")
        out.text(f"reconcile: production already runs {target_entry.release}; no PUT; health {health['health']}")
        _finish(
            ctx,
            kind="rollback",
            sha=target_entry.record_sha,
            images=dict(target_entry.images),
            previous=latest.release,
            rolled_back_from=latest.release,
            built_at="",
            reconciled=True,
            state=before,
            summary=[f"- Outcome: reconcile (no PUT); production runs {target_entry.release}"],
            handoff_outputs=handoff_outputs,
        )
        return EXIT_OK
    # P8 the image-only desired spec and the sanitized digest diff.
    desired_spec = spec_images.set_images(before.spec, desired_images)
    changed = spec_images.require_image_only_change(before.spec, desired_spec)
    if spec_images.environment_value_fingerprint(desired_spec) != before.public["environment_values_sha256"]:
        common.fail("topology-differs:environment")
    if spec_images.non_source_fingerprint(desired_spec) != before.public["non_source_projection_sha256"]:
        common.fail("topology-differs:non-source")
    spec_images.require_topology(desired_spec, target)
    diff_lines = [
        f"- {component}: {live_images[component]} -> {desired_images[component]}"
        + ("" if live_images[component] != desired_images[component] else " (unchanged)")
        for component in common.COMPONENTS
    ]
    out.emit(
        {
            "event": "digest-diff",
            "case": case,
            "components": {
                component: {"current": live_images[component], "desired": desired_images[component]}
                for component in common.COMPONENTS
            },
            "changed_spec_leaves": len(changed),
            "note": "environment/topology fingerprints unchanged, VPC bound",
        }
    )
    out.summary(["## Release production", "", f"- Mode: {mode} ({case})", f"- Commit: {sha}", *diff_lines,
                 f"- Changed spec leaves: {len(changed)}; environment/topology fingerprints unchanged, VPC bound"])
    if dispatched_mode == BYPASS_MODE:
        out.summary(["", *BYPASS_BANNER])
    # P9 dry-run: everything except the PUT.
    if mode == "dry-run":
        health = ctx.health(origin)
        again = do_app.observe_stable(client)
        if not _same_state(again, before):
            common.fail("cas-changed")
        if client.put_count() != 0:
            common.fail("internal-error:dry-run-put")
        out.text(f"dry-run complete: no PUT; current production health {health['health']}")
        out.summary(["- Outcome: dry-run complete, no PUT", ""])
        return EXIT_OK
    # P10 CAS immediately before the one PUT.
    cas = do_app.observe_stable(client)
    if not _same_state(cas, before):
        common.fail("cas-changed")
    # P11 exactly one PUT, never retried.
    run.put_attempted = True
    try:
        client.put_app_once(desired_spec)
    except common.AmbiguousMutation:
        out.text("the PUT outcome is ambiguous; reconciling with GETs only")
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        if exc.reason != "provider-rejected":
            raise
        try:
            unchanged = _same_state(do_app.observe_stable(client), before)
        except common.ReleaseError:
            unchanged = False
        if unchanged:
            run.put_attempted = False
            out.text("refused: provider-rejected; production unchanged")
            return EXIT_REFUSED
        out.text("provider-rejected, but production no longer equals the pre-PUT state")
        out.text(MANUAL_LINE)
        return EXIT_MANUAL
    # P12 GET-only reconcile until ACTIVE with PRE_DEPLOY SUCCESS on the web digest.
    rollback = _Rollback(ctx, run, token, secret, target, before, desired_spec, live_images, latest, origin)
    try:
        app_response, deployment_response, ambiguous, candidate_id = do_app.reconcile_until_active(
            client,
            desired_spec,
            job_name=common.PRE_DEPLOY_JOB,
            web_digest=desired_images["web"],
            exclude_ids={before.active_id},
            sleeper=deps.sleeper,
            poll_limit=deps.poll_limit,
        )
    except do_app.TerminalDeployment as exc:
        return rollback.execute("deployment-error", exc.deployment_id)
    except do_app.PostDeployGuard as exc:
        return rollback.execute("post-deploy-guard", getattr(exc, "deployment_id", None))
    except do_app.ReconcileTimeout:
        try:
            unchanged = _same_state(do_app.observe_stable(client), before)
        except common.ReleaseError:
            unchanged = False
        out.text("ambiguous-not-observed: the PUT never became visible" if unchanged else "reconcile-timeout")
        out.text(MANUAL_LINE)
        return EXIT_MANUAL
    out.add_mask(candidate_id)
    # P13 post-deploy guards.
    try:
        after = do_app.provider_snapshot(app_response, deployment_response, client.app_id)
        settled = do_app.observe_settled(client, sleeper=deps.sleeper, poll_limit=deps.poll_limit)
        do_app.require_materially_unchanged(after, settled)
        if spec_images.extract_image_digests(settled.spec) != desired_images:
            raise do_app.PostDeployGuard("post-deploy-guard:images")
        for key in ("environment_values_sha256", "non_source_projection_sha256"):
            if settled.public[key] != before.public[key]:
                raise do_app.PostDeployGuard("post-deploy-guard:fingerprint")
        spec_images.require_topology(settled.spec, target)
        do_app.migration_succeeded(settled.deployment, job_name=common.PRE_DEPLOY_JOB, web_digest=desired_images["web"])
        if client.put_count() != 1 or any(method not in {"GET", "PUT"} for method, _ in client.request_log):
            raise do_app.PostDeployGuard("post-deploy-guard:ledger")
    except common.ReleaseError:
        return rollback.execute("post-deploy-guard", candidate_id)
    # P14 blocking smoke in the same job.
    try:
        health = ctx.health(origin)
    except common.ReleaseError:
        return rollback.execute("smoke-failed", candidate_id)
    # P15 success.
    if case == "promote":
        assert candidate is not None
        kind, record_sha, built_at, rolled_back_from = "promote", sha, candidate["built_at"], ""
    elif case == "rollback":
        assert target_entry is not None
        kind, record_sha, built_at, rolled_back_from = "rollback", target_entry.record_sha, "", latest.release
    else:
        kind, record_sha, built_at, rolled_back_from = "restore", latest.record_sha, "", ""
    out.text(
        f"{kind} complete: health {health['health']}; one PUT"
        + (" (ambiguous, reconciled)" if ambiguous else "")
    )
    _finish(
        ctx,
        kind=kind,
        sha=record_sha,
        images=desired_images,
        previous=latest.release,
        rolled_back_from=rolled_back_from,
        built_at=built_at,
        reconciled=False,
        state=settled,
        summary=[f"- Outcome: {kind} deployed, health {health['health']}, one PUT"],
        handoff_outputs=handoff_outputs,
    )
    return EXIT_OK


def _mask_observation(out: common.Output, client: do_app.DOAppClient, snapshot: do_app.Snapshot) -> None:
    out.add_mask(snapshot.active_id)
    vpc = snapshot.spec.get("vpc")
    if type(vpc) is dict and type(vpc.get("id")) is str:
        out.add_mask(vpc["id"])
    for identity in sorted(client.observed_ids):
        out.add_mask(identity)


def _finish(
    ctx: Context,
    *,
    kind: str,
    sha: str,
    images: Mapping[str, str],
    previous: str,
    rolled_back_from: str,
    built_at: str,
    reconciled: bool,
    state: do_app.Snapshot,
    summary: Sequence[str],
    handoff_outputs: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> None:
    deployed_at = common.format_timestamp(ctx.now())
    release = f"prod-{common.compact_timestamp(deployed_at)}-{sha[:8]}"
    outputs = {
        "release": release,
        "kind": kind,
        "sha": sha,
        "previous": previous,
        "rolled_back_from": rolled_back_from,
        "deployed_at": deployed_at,
        "built_at": built_at,
        "reconciled": "true" if reconciled else "false",
        "environment_values_sha256": state.public["environment_values_sha256"],
        "non_source_projection_sha256": state.public["non_source_projection_sha256"],
    }
    for component in common.COMPONENTS:
        outputs[OUTPUT_DIGEST_KEYS[component]] = images[component]
    if handoff_outputs is not None:
        outputs.update(handoff_outputs)
    ctx.out.set_outputs(outputs)
    ctx.out.summary([*summary, f"- Record to write: {release}", ""])


class _Rollback:
    """AUTO-ROLLBACK: a separate client with its own single-PUT budget,
    re-PUTting the pre-PUT spec only if the live spec still equals what this
    run PUT."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: Context,
        run: _Run,
        token: str,
        secret: Mapping[str, str],
        target: Mapping[str, Any],
        before: do_app.Snapshot,
        desired_spec: Mapping[str, Any],
        live_images: Mapping[str, str],
        latest: ship_flow.record_resolver.ReleaseSelection,
        origin: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.run = run
        self._token = token
        self.secret = secret
        self.target = target
        self.before = before
        self.desired_spec = desired_spec
        self.live_images = dict(live_images)
        self.latest = latest
        self.origin = origin

    def _manual(self, reason: str) -> int:
        safe_text(self.ctx.out, f"automatic rollback stopped: {reason}")
        safe_text(self.ctx.out, MANUAL_LINE)
        return EXIT_MANUAL

    def execute(self, reason: str, failed_id: str | None) -> int:
        ctx = self.ctx
        out = ctx.out
        deps = ctx.deps
        out.add_mask(failed_id)
        safe_text(out, f"{reason}: starting the automatic rollback to the pre-PUT spec")
        rollback_client = do_app.DOAppClient(
            self.secret["app_id"],
            self.secret["postgres_cluster_id"],
            self._token,

RECORD_FIELDS = (

    "PREVIOUS", "ROLLED_BACK_FROM", "DEPLOYED_AT", "BUILT_AT", "RECONCILED",
    "ENVIRONMENT_VALUES_SHA256", "NON_SOURCE_PROJECTION_SHA256",
)


def _record_fields(env: Mapping[str, str], control: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    code = "record-invalid:inputs"
    raw = {name: env.get(f"REC_{name}", "") for name in RECORD_FIELDS}
    if any(type(value) is not str for value in raw.values()):
        common.fail(code)
    for value in raw.values():
        if value and common.OUTPUT_VALUE_RE.fullmatch(value) is None:
            common.fail(code)
    if raw["RECONCILED"] not in {"true", "false"}:
        common.fail(code)
    fields = {
        "kind": raw["KIND"],
        "release": raw["RELEASE"],
        "sha": raw["SHA"],
        "images": {
            "web": raw["WEB_DIGEST"],
            "meta-relay": raw["META_RELAY_DIGEST"],
            "gmail-relay": raw["GMAIL_RELAY_DIGEST"],
        },
        "previous": raw["PREVIOUS"],
        "rolled_back_from": raw["ROLLED_BACK_FROM"] or None,
        "reconciled": raw["RECONCILED"] == "true",
        "built_at": raw["BUILT_AT"] or None,
        "deployed_at": raw["DEPLOYED_AT"],
        "workflow_sha": control["workflow_sha"],
        "environment_values_sha256": raw["ENVIRONMENT_VALUES_SHA256"],
        "non_source_projection_sha256": raw["NON_SOURCE_PROJECTION_SHA256"],
    }
    try:
        release_record.build_manifest(fields)
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        raise common.ReleaseError(code) from exc
    if fields["kind"] == "promote" and fields["sha"] != control["sha"]:
        common.fail(code)
    return fields


def _record_paths(ctx: Context) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    directory = ctx.runner_temp() / "ship-record"
    return directory, directory / release_record.MANIFEST_ASSET


def _find_draft(gh: release_record.Gh, tag: str) -> bool:
    drafts = [
        release for release in gh.releases()
        if type(release) is dict and release.get("tag_name") == tag and release.get("draft") is True
    ]
    if len(drafts) > 1:
        common.fail("record-invalid:duplicate-draft")
    return bool(drafts)


def _record_state(ctx: Context, gh: release_record.Gh, raw: bytes, manifest: Mapping[str, Any],
                  control: Mapping[str, Any], fields: Mapping[str, Any], deadline: float) -> str:
    expected, state = ship_flow.record_bytes(ctx, control, fields, deadline=deadline)
    if expected != raw:
        common.fail("record-invalid:production-differs")
    if state == "published":
        return state
    return "draft" if _find_draft(gh, manifest["release"]) else "new"


def _load_local_manifest(ctx: Context) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, Any], Path]:
    _directory, path = _record_paths(ctx)
    if path.is_symlink() or not path.is_file():
        common.fail("record-invalid:local")
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    manifest = release_record.validate_manifest(common.loads_strict(raw, code="record-invalid:local"))
    if raw != common.canonical_file_bytes(manifest):
        common.fail("record-invalid:local")
    return raw, manifest, path


def render_notes(manifest: Mapping[str, Any], *, mode: str = "") -> list[str]:
    lines = [
        f"Release record {manifest['release']} ({manifest['kind']}).",
        "",
        "Written by the Release workflow (.github/workflows/ship.yml). The attested asset "
        "release-manifest.json is the record; these notes are informational only.",
        "",
        f"- Commit: {manifest['sha']}",
        *_digest_lines(manifest["images"]),
        f"- Previous record: {manifest['previous']}",
    ]
    if manifest["rolled_back_from"]:
        lines.append(f"- Rolled back from: {manifest['rolled_back_from']}")
    if manifest["reconciled"]:
        lines.append("- Reconciled: production already ran these digests; no PUT")
    if manifest["schema_version"] == 2:
        lines += [f"- Database change: {manifest['db_change']}; dormant: {str(manifest['dormant']).lower()}",
            f"- Catalog: version {manifest['catalog_version']}; minimum reader {manifest['min_reader_version']}",
            f"- Measured catalog SHA256: {manifest['catalog_sha256']}",
            f"- Compatibility: {manifest['compat']}; run: {manifest['compat_run_id'] or 'none'}",
            f"- Reversible: {str(manifest['reversible']).lower()}; old server: {str(manifest['old_server_ok']).lower()}",
            f"- Staging: {manifest['staging']}"]

        lines += ["", *BYPASS_BANNER]
    return lines


def cmd_record(ctx: Context, stage: str) -> int:
    # All visibility retries in this command share one original source budget.
    deadline = time.monotonic() + ship_flow.SOURCE_SECONDS
    control = common.validate_context(ctx.env, allow_rerun=True)
    out = ctx.out
    gh = ctx.gh()
    if stage == "manifest":
        fields = _record_fields(ctx.env, control)
        raw, state = ship_flow.record_bytes(ctx, control, fields, deadline=deadline)
        manifest = release_record.validate_manifest(common.loads_strict(raw, code="record-invalid"))
        if state != "published":
            state = "draft" if _find_draft(gh, manifest["release"]) else "new"
        directory, path = _record_paths(ctx)
        directory.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
        if path.exists() and path.read_bytes() != raw:
            common.fail("record-invalid:local")
        path.write_bytes(raw)
        out.set_outputs({"tag": manifest["release"], "path": str(path).replace("\\", "/"), "state": state})
        out.text(f"record {manifest['release']}: {state}")
    elif stage == "publish":
        raw, manifest, path = _load_local_manifest(ctx)
        fields = _record_fields(ctx.env, control)
        state = _record_state(ctx, gh, raw, manifest, control, fields, deadline)
        tag = manifest["release"]
        if state == "published":
            out.text(f"record {tag} is already published")
            return EXIT_OK
        notes = path.parent / "notes.md"
        lines = [common.require_public_text(line) for line in render_notes(manifest, mode=ctx.env.get("SHIP_MODE", ""))]
        notes.write_bytes(("\n".join(lines) + "\n").encode("ascii"))
        if state == "new":
            gh.run(
                ["release", "create", tag, "--repo", common.REPOSITORY, "--draft", "--target",
                 manifest["sha"], "--title", tag, "--notes-file", str(notes)],
                code="gh-failed:release-create",
            )
            gh.run(["release", "upload", tag, str(path), "--repo", common.REPOSITORY], code="gh-failed:release-upload")
        else:
            gh.run(
                ["release", "upload", tag, str(path), "--repo", common.REPOSITORY, "--clobber"],
                code="gh-failed:release-upload",
            )
        gh.run(["release", "edit", tag, "--repo", common.REPOSITORY, "--draft=false"], code="gh-failed:release-publish")
        out.text(f"record {tag} published")
    elif stage == "verify":
        raw, manifest, path = _load_local_manifest(ctx)
        tag = manifest["release"]
        last_error: common.ReleaseError | None = None
        for attempt in range(6):
            try:
                ship_flow.verify_published(ctx, raw, deadline=deadline)
                last_error = None
                break
            except common.ReleaseError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if attempt < 5 and time.monotonic() + 10 < deadline:
                    ctx.deps.sleeper(10)
                else:
                    break
        if last_error is not None:
            raise last_error
        out.text(f"record {tag} verified: attested, tag bound to {manifest['sha']}, latest in the chain")
        out.summary(["## Release record", "", *render_notes(manifest, mode=ctx.env.get("SHIP_MODE", "")), ""])
    else:
        common.fail("input-invalid:stage")
    return EXIT_OK


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# entry point
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="ship.py",
        description="Release workflow controls (.github/workflows/ship.yml).",
    )
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    commands.add_parser("plan", help="verify CI, records and guards before approval")
    image = commands.add_parser("image", help="images job stages")
    image.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=("pins", "contract", "trivy-db", "record"))
    image.add_argument("--component", required=True, choices=common.COMPONENTS)
    commands.add_parser("trivy-policy", help="validate the reviewed expiring exceptions")
    candidate = commands.add_parser("candidate", help="attest job stages")
    candidate.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=("read", "verify", "assemble"))
    commands.add_parser("production", help="verify, guard, deploy, smoke and roll back")
    record = commands.add_parser("record", help="record job stages")
    record.add_argument("--stage", required=True, choices=("manifest", "publish", "verify"))
    return parser


def main(
    argv: Sequence[str] | None = None,
    env: MutableMapping[str, str] | None = None,
    deps: Deps | None = None,
) -> int:
    environment = os.environ if env is None else env
    dependencies = deps or Deps()
    arguments = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    out = common.Output(
        stdout=dependencies.stdout or sys.stdout,
        summary_path=environment.get("GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"),
        output_path=environment.get("GITHUB_OUTPUT"),
    )
    ctx = Context(environment, dependencies, out)
    if arguments.command == "production":
        return run_production(ctx)
    try:
        if arguments.command == "plan":
            return cmd_plan(ctx)
        if arguments.command == "image":
            return cmd_image(ctx, arguments.stage, arguments.component)
        if arguments.command == "trivy-policy":
            return cmd_trivy_policy(ctx)
        if arguments.command == "candidate":
            return cmd_candidate(ctx, arguments.stage)
        if arguments.command == "record":
            return cmd_record(ctx, arguments.stage)
        common.fail("input-invalid:command")
    except schema_change.SchemaChangeBlocked as exc:
        report_schema_block(out, exc)
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except common.ReleaseError as exc:
        safe_text(out, f"refused: {exc.code}")
        return EXIT_REFUSED
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - never print a traceback or a value
        safe_text(out, "refused: internal-error")
        return EXIT_REFUSED


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

            namespace = coverage.namespaces[namespace_position]; namespace_position += 1
            _need(type(namespace) is resolver.PublisherNamespace and namespace.source_sha == source_sha
                  and type(namespace.raw) is bytes
                  and len(namespace.raw) <= resolver.source_git.PUBLISHER_NAMESPACE_LIMIT, "namespace-role")
            total += len(namespace.raw)
            _need(total <= negative.MAX_SOURCE_TOTAL, "source-bound")
            namespaces.append(resolver.source_git.publisher_namespace(namespace.raw))
        if any(row is None for row in namespaces):
            matches = False
        else:
            matches &= (tuple(row[:3] for row in namespaces[0]) == tuple(row[:3] for row in namespaces[1]))
        namespace_maps = tuple({row[0]: row for row in rows} if rows is not None else {}
                               for rows in namespaces)
        for row in lineage.inventory:
            for role, source_sha in enumerate((lineage.producer_sha, sha)):
                blob = coverage.blobs[position]; position += 1
                _need(type(blob) is resolver.PublisherBlob and blob.source_sha == source_sha
                      and blob.path == row.path, "blob-role")
                if blob.raw is None:
                    _need(blob.mode is None, "blob-absence")
                    matches = False
                else:
                    _need(type(blob.raw) is bytes and len(blob.raw) <= negative.MAX_SOURCE
                          and type(blob.mode) is str and blob.mode in ("100644", "100755"), "blob")
                    total += len(blob.raw)
                    _need(total <= negative.MAX_SOURCE_TOTAL, "source-bound")
                    matches &= (blob.mode == row.mode and len(blob.raw) == row.byte_count
                                and common.sha256_bytes(blob.raw) == row.sha256)
                    if any(row.path.startswith(root + "/") for root in resolver.source_git._PUBLISHER_ROOTS):
                        oid = hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(blob.raw)).encode("ascii") + b"\0" + blob.raw).hexdigest()
                        matches &= namespace_maps[role].get(row.path) == (row.path, blob.mode, "blob", oid)
        # Deterministic sorted policy order; no caller-selected producer.
        if matches and not covered:
            covered = True
    _need(covered, "uncovered")
    return parsed


def _eligible(source, checked_at):
    resolution = source.admission.resolution
    latest, candidate, change = resolution.resolved.latest, resolution.candidate, resolution.classification
    live = latest.live
    _need(change.kind == "none" and change.dormant is False and not change.reasons
          and not change.migration_changes and live is not None
          and source.admission.contract_observation is None, "class")
    _need(latest.record_sha == live.origin_source.sha == resolution.database_base_source
          and candidate.mode == latest.reader.mode == live.origin_source.mode == "reviewed-v0"
          and candidate.artifacts == latest.reader.artifacts == live.origin_source.artifacts
          and tuple(path for path, _ in candidate.artifacts) == tuple(sorted(policy.SOURCE_PATHS))
          and candidate.catalog == live.catalog == latest.reader.catalog == live.origin_source.catalog,
          "live-material")
    gate = forward_gates.observe_forward_drills(resolution, now=checked_at)
    _need(gate.required is False, "drills")
    forward_gates.validate_preserved_contract(resolution, None)


def _preserved_common(value):
    _need(type(value) is OutagePreflight, "preserved-type")
    _need(type(value.command_count) is int and 0 < value.command_count <= normal.MAX_COMMANDS
          and type(value.captured_bytes) is int and 0 < value.captured_bytes <= normal.MAX_BYTES
          and type(value.remaining_us) is int and 0 < value.remaining_us <= OUTAGE_FRESHNESS_SECONDS * 1_000_000,
          "bounds")
    entry, checked, until = _utc(value.entry_at), _utc(value.checked_at), _utc(value.valid_until)
    _need(entry <= checked < until and until == min(
        checked + timedelta(microseconds=value.remaining_us), entry + timedelta(seconds=OUTAGE_FRESHNESS_SECONDS)),
        "validity")
    parsed = _coverage(value.source)
    _eligible(value.source, checked)
    available = value.availability
    _need(type(available) in (ServiceUnavailable, MissingExpiredEvidence)
          and type(available.observation) is negative.HttpObservation, "availability")
    observed = negative.replay_http(available.observation.raw, endpoint=negative.ACTIONS_ENDPOINT)
    _need(negative._same(observed, available.observation), "service")
    _need(entry <= _utc(available.observed_at), "service-clock")
    if type(available) is ServiceUnavailable:
        _need(observed.status in (502, 503, 504), "unavailable")
        history_at = available.observed_at
    else:
        _need(observed.status == 200 and type(available.collected) is collect.CollectedOutageHistory,
              "missing")
        history_at = _utc(available.collected.normal.history.observed_at)
        _need(available.observed_at <= _utc(available.collected.started_at) <= history_at
              and value.command_count >= available.collected.normal.command_count
              and value.captured_bytes >= available.collected.normal.captured_bytes, "history-clock")
    snapshot = value.index
    _need(type(snapshot) is negative.IndexSnapshot
          and type(snapshot.before_rule) is negative.RuleView and type(snapshot.after_rule) is negative.RuleView
          and type(snapshot.before_refs) is negative.RefInventory and type(snapshot.after_refs) is negative.RefInventory,
          "index")
    replayed = negative.replay_index(parsed.setup, snapshot.before_rule.raw, snapshot.before_refs.raw,
        snapshot.after_rule.raw, snapshot.after_refs.raw, producer_sha=value.source.admission.resolution.candidate.sha,
        started_at=snapshot.started_at, observed_at=snapshot.observed_at)
    _need(negative._same(replayed, snapshot) and not replayed.before_refs.rows and not replayed.after_refs.rows,
          "negative-intent")
    _need(history_at <= _utc(snapshot.started_at) <= _utc(snapshot.observed_at) <= checked, "index-clock")
    return value


def validate_preserved(value):
    """Current raw replay; counters prove bounds, not process-transcript truth."""
    try:
        _need(type(value) is OutagePreflight and type(value.source) is resolver.OutageForwardResolution
              and type(value.source.admission) is resolver.ForwardAdmission, "preserved-type")
        resolution = value.source.admission.resolution
        bridge.validate_current_source(resolution)
        _preserved_common(value)
        if type(value.availability) is MissingExpiredEvidence:
            collected = value.availability.collected
            request = bridge.build_request(resolution, collected.normal)
            collect.require_missing_expired(request, collected, workflow=resolution.workflow)
        return value
    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "outage-preflight-preserved-invalid") from None


def _validate_preserved_custody(value):

    try:
        _need(type(value) is OutagePreflight and type(value.source) is resolver.OutageForwardResolution
              and type(value.source.admission) is resolver.ForwardAdmission, "preserved-type")
        resolution = value.source.admission.resolution
        bridge._validate_source_custody(resolution)
        _preserved_common(value)
        if type(value.availability) is MissingExpiredEvidence:
            collected = value.availability.collected
            request = bridge._build_context3_custody_request(resolution, collected.normal)
            collect._require_missing_expired_custody(request, collected, workflow=resolution.workflow)

    except evidence.CompatRefusal:

def _source(budget, repo, sha, gh, git, token, phase, env):

    operation = transport.OperationBudget(budget.end, capture=budget.capture, clock=budget.clock)
    try:
        client = transport.ReleaseGh(gh, token, phase / "config", phase / "work",
                                     budget=operation, base_env=env)
        return resolver.resolve_outage_forward(client, repo, git, sha)
    except Exception:

        raise
    finally:

def _preflight(repo_dir, candidate_sha, *, gh_binary, git_binary, token, scratch_dir,
               deadline, capture, clock, wall_clock, base_env):
    installed = loader.load_consumer_policy()
    if installed is None:
        return normal._preflight(repo_dir, candidate_sha, gh_binary=gh_binary, git_binary=git_binary,
            token=token, scratch_dir=scratch_dir, deadline=deadline, capture=capture,
            clock=clock, wall_clock=wall_clock, base_env=base_env)
    budget = normal._Budget(deadline, capture=capture, clock=clock)
    # Keep the configured outage operation and wire8 validity on their original
    # clock/window; the ordinary normal fallback above uses the larger window.
    budget.end = min(budget.end, budget._last + OUTAGE_FRESHNESS_SECONDS)
    index_operation = None
    try:
        entry = _utc(wall_clock())
        _need(type(candidate_sha) is str and common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(candidate_sha), "source")
        _need(type(token) is str and 0 < len(token) <= 4096 and all(33 <= ord(c) <= 126 for c in token), "token")
        normal._regular(repo_dir, directory=True)
        normal._regular(gh_binary); normal._regular(git_binary)
        normal._scratch(scratch_dir, repo_dir)
        index_dir = scratch_dir / "negative-index"
        index_dir.mkdir(mode=0o700); (index_dir / "config").mkdir(mode=0o700)
        budget.bind(scratch_dir, gh_binary, git_binary)
        env = common.scrubbed_env(base=base_env)
        before = _source(budget, repo_dir, candidate_sha, gh_binary, git_binary, token,
                         scratch_dir / "source-before", env)
        bridge.validate_current_source(before.admission.resolution)
        _need(before.coverage.policy_raw == installed.raw, "policy-changed")
        index_operation = transport.OperationBudget(budget.end, capture=budget.capture, clock=clock)
        reader = index_transport.open_reader(gh_binary, token, index_dir / "config",
                                             budget=index_operation, base_env=env)
        _need(reader.setup.raw == installed.setup.raw, "setup-changed")
        raw = reader.observe_actions_service()
        service = negative.replay_http(raw, endpoint=negative.ACTIONS_ENDPOINT)
        service_at = _utc(wall_clock())
        _need(entry <= service_at, "service-clock")
        qualified = history = None
        if service.status == 200:
            phase = scratch_dir / "actions"
            client = collect.ActionsGh(str(gh_binary), token, phase / "config",
                seconds=min(600, budget.remaining()), base_env=env, capture=budget.capture, clock=clock)
            history = collect.collect_outage_history(collect.CollectionRequest(candidate_sha,
                before.admission.resolution.workflow), client, phase / "work", wall_clock=wall_clock)
            collect.validate_outage_history(history, workflow=before.admission.resolution.workflow,
                                            producer_sha=candidate_sha)
            try:
                qualified = bridge.qualify(before.admission.resolution, history.normal)
            except evidence.CompatRefusal:
                # Only a pure policy result chooses this branch; never a failed
                # capture/collection retry or a supplied unavailable enum.
                request = bridge.build_request(before.admission.resolution, history.normal)
                collect.require_missing_expired(request, history, workflow=before.admission.resolution.workflow)
            availability = MissingExpiredEvidence(service, service_at, history)
        else:
            _need(service.status in (502, 503, 504), "service")
            availability = ServiceUnavailable(service, service_at)
        budget.check()
        if qualified is None:
            _coverage(before)
            _eligible(before, service_at)
            started = _utc(wall_clock())
            first_rule, first_refs = reader.read_rule(), reader.read_refs(candidate_sha)
        after = _source(budget, repo_dir, candidate_sha, gh_binary, git_binary, token,
                        scratch_dir / "source-after", env)
        budget.check()
        observed = history.normal.history.observed_at if history is not None else service_at
        contract = normal._contract_pair(before.admission, after.admission, observed)
        _need(before.coverage == after.coverage, "source-changed")
        if qualified is not None:
            qualified = bridge.qualify(after.admission.resolution, history.normal)
            checked = _utc(wall_clock())
            _need(entry <= service_at <= history.started_at <= observed <= checked, "clock")
            _need(contract is None or contract.observed_at <= checked, "contract-clock")
            drills = forward_gates.observe_forward_drills(after.admission.resolution, now=checked)
            budget.check()
            return normal.NormalPreflight(after.admission.resolution, qualified, history.normal,
                budget.commands, budget.captured_bytes, drills, contract)
        last_rule, last_refs = reader.read_rule(), reader.read_refs(candidate_sha)
        index_at = _utc(wall_clock())
        snapshot = negative.replay_index(installed.setup, first_rule, first_refs, last_rule, last_refs,
            producer_sha=candidate_sha, started_at=started, observed_at=index_at)
        budget.check()
        checked = _utc(wall_clock())
        remaining = int(budget.remaining() * 1_000_000)
        until = min(checked + timedelta(microseconds=remaining), entry + timedelta(seconds=OUTAGE_FRESHNESS_SECONDS))
        value = OutagePreflight(after, availability, snapshot, entry, checked, remaining, until,
                               budget.commands, budget.captured_bytes)
        validate_preserved(value)
        budget.check()
        return value
    except Exception:
        budget.failed = True
        if index_operation is not None:
            index_operation.failed = True
        raise
    finally:
        try:
            if index_operation is not None:
                index_operation.close()
        finally:
            budget.close()


def preflight(repo_dir: Path, candidate_sha: str, *, gh_binary: Path, git_binary: Path,
              token: str, scratch_dir: Path, deadline: float):

            token=token, scratch_dir=scratch_dir, deadline=deadline, capture=runtime.bounded_command,
            clock=time.monotonic, wall_clock=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), base_env=os.environ)
    except (evidence.CompatRefusal, common.ReleaseError):
        raise
    except Exception:
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal("compat-stale", "outage-preflight-invalid") from None
"""Concrete rollback admission, without transferable operational authority.

Three fresh closed phases share the original outer capture allowance. Complete
source and all-head evidence are retained. The separate named admission route
keeps legacy and zero/one-change transitions free of Actions evidence reads.
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import os
from pathlib import Path
import time

import compat_evidence as evidence
import compat_envelope as envelope
import compat_request as bridge
import compat_rollback_collect as collect
import compat_rollback_history as history
import record_resolver as resolver
import record_transport as transport
import ship_compat as normal

common, runtime = transport.common, transport.runtime
ROLLBACK_MAX_SECONDS = 900


def _need(value, detail):
    if not value:
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal('compat-stale', 'rollback-preflight-' + detail)


def _utc(value):
    _need(type(value) is datetime and value.tzinfo is timezone.utc and value.fold == 0,
          'clock')
    return value


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RollbackPreflight:
    """Observed data only; checked_at/expiry are not a permission lifetime."""
    resolution: resolver.RollbackProofResolution = field(repr=False)
    qualified: history.QualifiedRollback
    collected: history.CollectedRollbackHistory = field(repr=False)
    command_count: int
    captured_bytes: int
    checked_at: datetime
    artifact_expires_at: datetime
    entry_at: datetime


def _source(budget, repo, producer, target, gh, git, token, phase, env, *, admission=False):
    budget.check()
    operation = transport.OperationBudget(budget.end, capture=budget.capture, clock=budget.clock)
    try:
        client = transport.ReleaseGh(gh, token, phase / 'config', phase / 'work',
                                     budget=operation, base_env=env)
        if admission:
            return resolver.resolve_rollback_admission(client, repo, git, producer, target)
        return resolver.resolve_rollback_proof(client, repo, git, producer, target)
    except Exception:
        operation.failed = True
        raise
    finally:
        operation.close()


def _actions(budget, repo, producer, gh, git, token, phase, env, wall_clock):
    budget.check()
    operation = transport.OperationBudget(budget.end, capture=budget.capture, clock=budget.clock)
    try:
        return collect._collect(producer, repo, gh_binary=gh, git_binary=git, token=token,
            config_dir=phase / 'config', scratch=phase / 'work', budget=operation,
            wall_clock=wall_clock, base_env=env)
    except Exception:
        operation.failed = True
        raise
    finally:
        operation.close()


def _expiry(qualified, collected, checked_at):
    """Check retained selected metadata without inventing a later observation."""
    source = next(row for row in collected.history.workflows
                  if row.sha == qualified.binding.producer_sha)
    matches = []
    for row in collected.history.attempts:
        run = common.loads_strict(row.envelope.raw)['run']
        if (run['id'], run['run_attempt']) == (qualified.run_id, qualified.run_attempt):
            matches.append(row)
    _need(len(matches) == 1, 'selected-attempt')
    replayed = envelope.replay(source, matches[0].envelope,
                              observed_at=collected.history.observed_at)
    artifacts = [item for item in replayed.artifacts
                 if (item.id, item.name) == (qualified.artifact_id, qualified.artifact_name)]
    _need(len(artifacts) == 1 and artifacts[0].expired is False
          and checked_at < artifacts[0].expires, 'artifact-expired')
    return artifacts[0].expires


def _preflight(repo_dir, producer_sha, target_tag, *, gh_binary, git_binary, token,
               scratch_dir, deadline, capture, clock, wall_clock, base_env, admission=False):
    """Only command/time seams are injectable here, never favorable facts."""
    budget = normal._Budget(deadline, capture=capture, clock=clock)
    # Preserve the rollback window using the original constructor clock sample.
    budget.end = min(budget.end, budget._last + ROLLBACK_MAX_SECONDS)
    try:
        entry_utc = _utc(wall_clock())
        _need(type(producer_sha) is str and common.SHA1_RE.fullmatch(producer_sha), 'source')
        _need(type(target_tag) is str and (target_tag == common.BOOTSTRAP_TAG
              or common.RECORD_TAG_RE.fullmatch(target_tag)), 'target')
        _need(type(token) is str and 0 < len(token) <= 8192
              and not any(char in token for char in '\r\n\0'), 'token')
        normal._regular(repo_dir, directory=True)
        normal._regular(gh_binary)
        normal._regular(git_binary)
        normal._scratch(scratch_dir, repo_dir)
        budget.bind(scratch_dir, gh_binary, git_binary)
        env = common.scrubbed_env(base=base_env)
        before = _source(budget, repo_dir, producer_sha, target_tag, gh_binary, git_binary,
                         token, scratch_dir / 'source-before', env, admission=admission)
        budget.check()
        if admission and type(before) is resolver.RollbackResolution:
            # Its source operation already performed complete final checks.
            # Do not fetch any Actions evidence for legacy or zero/one spans.
            return before
        collected = _actions(budget, repo_dir, producer_sha, gh_binary, git_binary,
                             token, scratch_dir / 'actions', env, wall_clock)
        budget.check()
        after = _source(budget, repo_dir, producer_sha, target_tag, gh_binary, git_binary,
                        token, scratch_dir / 'source-after', env, admission=admission)
        budget.check()
        _need(type(before) is resolver.RollbackProofResolution and before == after,
              'source-changed')
        qualified = bridge.qualify_rollback(after, collected)
        budget.check()
        checked_at = _utc(wall_clock())
        _need(entry_utc <= collected.history.observed_at <= checked_at, 'clock')
        expires = _expiry(qualified, collected, checked_at)
        budget.check()
        return RollbackPreflight(after, qualified, collected, budget.commands,
                                 budget.captured_bytes, checked_at, expires, entry_utc)
    except (evidence.CompatRefusal, common.ReleaseError, resolver.policy.PolicyRefusal,
            resolver.schema_change.SchemaChangeBlocked):
        budget.failed = True
        raise
    except Exception:
        budget.fail('invalid')
    finally:
        budget.close()


def preflight(repo_dir: Path, producer_sha: str, target_tag: str, *, gh_binary: Path,
              git_binary: Path, token: str, scratch_dir: Path,
              deadline: float) -> RollbackPreflight:
    """Prepare exact target/live proof from fresh concrete source and history.

    deadline is the caller's original absolute monotonic deadline. The shared
    outer maximum remains 900 seconds, 6000 commands and 128MiB across all three
    phases. Each phase closes independently and never renews those allowances.
    Scratch is create-only and outside the repository. Artifacts are retained
    facts, not deleted-history coverage or a promise of future source freshness.
    This function is not called by operational rollback, restore or publication.
    """
    return _preflight(repo_dir, producer_sha, target_tag, gh_binary=gh_binary,
        git_binary=git_binary, token=token, scratch_dir=scratch_dir, deadline=deadline,
        capture=runtime.bounded_command, clock=time.monotonic,
        wall_clock=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), base_env=os.environ)


def admit(repo_dir: Path, producer_sha: str, target_tag: str, *, gh_binary: Path,
          git_binary: Path, token: str, scratch_dir: Path,
          deadline: float) -> resolver.RollbackResolution | RollbackPreflight:
    """Fresh exact-target source policy, fetching compatibility only if needed.

    The protected caller repeats this operation before provider effects. The
    public no-proof rollback policy is unchanged; a multiple-change result
    must complete the dedicated source/Actions/source path without new caps.
    """
    return _preflight(repo_dir, producer_sha, target_tag, gh_binary=gh_binary,
        git_binary=git_binary, token=token, scratch_dir=scratch_dir, deadline=deadline,
        capture=runtime.bounded_command, clock=time.monotonic,
        wall_clock=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), base_env=os.environ, admission=True)


def validate_preserved(value: RollbackPreflight) -> RollbackPreflight:
    """Pure original-time replay for closed custody, never a fresh permission.

    The codec/writer must bind the original protected workflow execution and
    exact parent independently. No caller-provided verdict, retry clock or
    deserialized type establishes source or signature provenance.
    """
    try:
        _need(type(value) is RollbackPreflight and type(value.qualified) is history.QualifiedRollback,
              'preserved-type')
        _need(type(value.command_count) is int and 0 < value.command_count <= normal.MAX_COMMANDS
              and type(value.captured_bytes) is int and 0 < value.captured_bytes <= normal.MAX_BYTES,
              'preserved-bounds')
        qualified = bridge.qualify_rollback(value.resolution, value.collected)
        _need(value.qualified == qualified, 'preserved-qualification')
        _need(_utc(value.entry_at) <= value.collected.history.observed_at <= _utc(value.checked_at)
              and value.command_count >= value.collected.command_count
              and value.captured_bytes >= value.collected.captured_bytes, 'preserved-clock')
        expires = _expiry(qualified, value.collected, value.checked_at)
        _need(_utc(value.artifact_expires_at) == expires, 'preserved-expiry')
        return value
    except evidence.CompatRefusal:
        raise
    except (common.ReleaseError, resolver.policy.PolicyRefusal, ValueError, TypeError,
            AttributeError, KeyError, IndexError, StopIteration, RecursionError, OverflowError):
        raise evidence.CompatRefusal('compat-stale', 'rollback-preflight-preserved-invalid') from None
